198000.description:
Amagiri-ya is a prestigious family of exorcists. Its descendant, Miyoshi Tenma, was not keen on taking over as head of the family. The reason was his father's death. Seeing his father lose his life while exorcising an evil spirit, he began to have doubts about this job. Then, the current head of the family suddenly declared, "The next head of the family will be decided not only by blood ties but also by ability." While Tenma was confused, Makoto, a genius exorcist from outside the family, became a candidate for succession for financial gain. Tenma was wary of her as she ignored the rules and continued to exorcise evil spirits, but...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: エスパー風紀委員長の失敗オナニー
title.romaji: Esper Fuuki Iinchou no Shippai Onanie Houkairoku

198002.description:
The moment his beloved daughter, Louise, was born, the protagonist, Wolfgang, remembered that he had been reincarnated into the world of the otome game "Blue Maiden Fantasy," and that his beloved daughter would one day become a villainous young lady! Wolfgang was soon bereaved and overcome with grief. In the game, Louise grew up to be a spoiled villainous young lady after his wife's death, but he overcame his grief and stood up for his daughter's happiness. This is the story of a father's struggle to prevent his precious daughter from becoming a villainous young lady, as he tries to resist fate, known as the game scenario!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: My Darling Daughter Is the Villainess

title.romaji: Ore no Manamusume wa Akuyaku Reijou

198003.description:
Everyone has a divine mark, a sign of talent. The blessings of the gods are supposed to be showered equally on everyone, but Shion, a dropout adventurer, is branded as incompetent with no divine mark. However, he refuses to give up on his growth, and when a hero he admires appears before him, a major turning point in his life begins! This is the story of a boy (and his master) who went from being "incompetent" to now "all-round talented" and rises to power!!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: 魔剣の弟子は無能で最強！～英雄流の修行で万能になれたので、最強を目指します～
title.romaji: Maken no Deshi wa Munou de Saikyou! Eiyuuryuu no Shugyou de Bannou ni Nareta node, Saikyou wo Mezashimasu

198004.description:
One summer day, kindhearted high school student Kaisei finds a mysterious young man collapsed on the street and carries him to his dorm room. The young man ends up staying there, but he refuses to reveal anything about himself, so the dorm’s residents dub him “Nora,” a name that means “Stray.” As Kaisei and Nora spend more time together, Kaisei begins to understand why Nora ran away from home. In turn, Kaisei, who always keeps a distance from others, opens up about his own bottled-up pain and regret.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

198005.description:
Right before we die, an angel comes to our side and waits for the moment when it can ferry our soul to Heaven. In the case of Rin, a pop singer who has just been dumped by her producer boyfriend, it's because her angel is present that she can't commit suicide. She can see the handsome angel Faye, who won't leave her side until his mission to collect her soul is complete...

Note: Published in Bessatsu Shoujo Comic 1998-12

title.native: カプセル・ヨードチンキ

198008.description:
A new take on a classic tale, Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Jane Watson attempt to solve a strange and supernatural death in a fictionalized version of 19th century Britain. With the country at war, Sherlock and Jane soon realize that they have uncovered an intricate network of secrets that leads to a much larger and more dangerous plan that puts the whole world at risk.

(Source: SpotToon)

198009.description:
Kyun-Woo is the model employee—efficient, respected, and perfectly composed. But beneath his spotless image hides a secret he refuses to name: a submissive yearning tied to urophilia. He has kept that desire buried, dismissing it as shameful and unreal. That is, until one day he catches a glimpse of Hyo-Won, his new junior, silently struggling to hold it in. Something fractures. Something awakens. And for the first time, Kyun-Woo finds himself craving a role he never dared to imagine... one that would place him entirely beneath someone else’s control.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

198010.description: The second season of Sherlock - Her Majesty's Detective.

198012.description:
Friday, humanity's only superhero with overwhelming power, has appeared! Earth faces a crisis of apocalypse due to a single hero. Is it Friday who will destroy humanity, or is it their own evil nature?

(Source: Naver, translated)

198013.description:
Sol, a college student, returns home for the first time in three years, only to find her mother Mi-ae living with a young guy named Romi Oh. At first, she thinks he’s Mi-ae’s boyfriend, but it turns out they’re just housemates. Sol somehow ends up living with them, although she doesn’t like Romi at all. She believes he’s too brazen and carefree. However, in time, she finds herself inexplicably drawn to him…

(Source: WEBTOON)

198014.description:
Avid BL lover Min Kirin attends a game expo to get some new BL games, but there are disappointingly few there. He nearly goes home empty-handed, but a mysterious, hooded man gives him a free copy of a VR BL game. Kirin is suspicious of the man and game, especially given the negative reviews, but he can't resist its mature rating and logs in just to be transported into that world! He needs to earn money and that's how he meets the various romanceable characters. Will Kirin find love with one of them and return to reality, or will he be unable to pick just one virtual hottie?!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: そうだ！今から僕とヤらない？〜BLゲームの主人公に憑依しちゃいました〜
De noob à dieu du sexe
ทะลุมิติพิชิตบัลลังก์
都開始玩了，就要當上王

title.english: May as Well Get the Best Ending

198015.description:
From failed auditions to broken dreams, Ha-Yun thought his acting career was over before it began. Now a small-time streamer, he’s ready to give up on the spotlight for good…until a mysterious indie director makes him an offer that’s impossible to ignore. One risky role, one intimate frame, and suddenly, Ha-Yun’s world is about to blur the line between performance and desire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: Our Member! It's Time for Your Heart

198019.description: Manga adaptation of Leo Tolstoy's 1886 short story "Ivan The Fool".

198020.description:
A hungry tree, a shapeshifting rat, and a forgotten boy... These are just three of the 100 curses that haunt Illeston Manor. House Illeston thinks they'll be plagued by their curses forever until Simone the necromancer shows up to break them. All she asks for in return is a lavish life and protection from anyone who might harm her. But with every ghoul she defeats, Simone realizes that the true dangers lie within the manor itself. Can Simone save House Illeston? Or will she die trying...?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The 100 Curses of the Illeston Mansion

198021.description:
College freshman Da-in Kim enters Myeongmun University determined to craft the perfect campus life: top grades, meaningful friendships, and even a handsome boyfriend. However, her plans unravel quickly after meeting her stunningly beautiful namesake, Da-in Kang, and a reserved guy named Su-hyeon Cha. When Su-hyeon publicly rejects her in favor of the “prettier” Da-in, her carefully built vision begins to collapse. Surrounded by students chasing their own ideal selves, can Da-in figure out what perfection really means?

(Source: WEBTOON)

198022.description:
Olivia Liberty is the first commoner ever admitted to Herolington University. However, she cannot be properly recognized because she is a woman and must instead use the name of a man, Oliver, to receive credit for her creations. Meanwhile, Noah Astrid, Prince of Herod, takes notice of Olivia, who is beloved by the commoners of Herod. Noah seeks to involve her in royal affairs to raise the royal family’s popularity and asks for her hand. But while every other member of the royal family treats Olivia affectionately, Noah alone continues to treat her coldly. Will he come to regret it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

198023.description: First version of Mutant Sabu, serialized in magazine Shoujo, from 1961-09 until 1962-01.
synonyms: 石森章太郎作品集〈1〉ミュータント・サブ

198024.description:
"Wanted: People who don't care what happens to their lives! Monthly salary: ¥150,000~ ※Must live on-site"

With no savings or home left, wandering aimlessly, Takahiro stumbled upon this job listing - managing an apartment unit as a live-in caretaker. The employment condition: "You must get along with your neighbors." Having nowhere else to go, Takahiro drifts into the apartment... only to find his "neighbors" are clearly not human.

"This is a story I heard from a friend..."

Every day, his neighbors tell him "ghost stories" - fictional tales of events that never happened in reality. At least, that's what they should have been—

A wildly popular horror story from Kakuyomu, now adapted into manga!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Conditions for Moving In: Be Sure to Get Along With the People Who Live Next Door

title.native: 入居条件：隣に住んでる友人と必ず仲良くしてください
title.romaji: Nyuukyo Jouken: Tonari ni Sunderu Yuujin to Kanarazu Nakayoku Shite Kudasai

198025.description:
Matsuura, a high school boy, has always lived his life by putting up a front. Easily able to discern the true nature hidden behind others' smiles, he encounters a formidable opponent in the form of a cheerful, twin-tailed beauty named Kyuuragi. Whether it's intentional or innocent, her every move and gesture is cunningly calculated, catching Matsuura off guard... "Stop it! I'm going to fall for you!!!"

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: Stop, I'm falling in love with you

title.native: やめろ好きになってしまう

198026.description:
Yui Ichinoi has a hard time making friends because of her past being bullied. That's why she decided to go to high school which is quite far from her home. There she meets Haruma Sakura, a popular boy who has many friends. Wishing to be like Sakura on Tanabata Day... Who would have thought Ichinoi's wish would actually come true?!

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: ปาฏิหาริย์รักคืนทานาบาตะ

198027.description: Takato Washimi, a third-year employee at a toy company, is troubled and worn down after struggling to get his project approved. One day, he encounters a bunny girl in the city, and his life changes completely. His work fatigue, worries, and mistakes—everything is soothed and purified by a sexy bunny girl! An invitation to a night time dreamland! Welcome to the bunny girl bar, Jackpot!
synonyms: Usamimi Jackpot in the Bunny Girl's Bar♥

You can freely control the minds and actions of people with this new multipurpose remote control! Get it while stocks last! Welcome to the new fun and fantastic world of controlling humans!

(Source: DLSite)

title.romaji: Sodachi no Ii Meikko wo Onaho Atsukai shite Ageta Hanashi

198032.description:
Audrey, a noble lady in name only, spends her days toiling at a magic gemstone store. Born without the magical powers required to fulfill her dream of becoming an appraiser, she’s treated as the lowest of the low at work. To make matters worse, the young company president coldly breaks off their engagement, Just when she thinks she’s hit rock bottom, a genie emerges in front of her from a quartz stone and forms a magical pact with her! With her newfound powers, Audrey can finally start a free life as magical gem appraiser and carve out a shining future!

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: Botsuraku Reijou no Okinimesumama: Konyaku Haki Sareta node Houseki Kanteishi to Shite Dokuritsu Shimasu

title.english: The Free Life of the Forlorn Lady: Shining On as a Gem Appraiser After Getting Dumped

title.romaji: Botsuraku Reijou no Oki ni Mesu Mama: Konyaku Haki Sareta node Houseki Kanteishi to Shite Dokuritsu Shimasu

198034.description:
After dying alone, office worker Aki awakens to find her soul inside the body of a noblewoman named Isabelle, a girl from a powerful ducal family.

Isabelle was known for being arrogant and hated by all— Her family ignored her, and even the one she loved coldly rejected her. She died unloved, with a shattered heart.

But Aki, who also suffered from loneliness in her previous life, made a firm decision: "If no one else will love her… then I will."

However, she soon starts noticing strange things about the people around her… Was everything she thought she knew about "Isabelle" really true? Or are there hidden truths that were never told?
synonyms: I will love the hated daughter. Even if you dote on her now. It's already too late!

title.native: 嫌われ者の令嬢は、私が愛しましょう。～いまさら溺愛してきても、もう遅いです！～
title.romaji: Kirawaremono no Reijou wa, Watashi ga Aishimashou. Imasara Dekiai shitekitemo, Mou Osoi Desu!

198035.description:
Chloe, the daughter of the Marquess of Merdikal, is the ornamental fiancée of Kirif, the second prince of the Adanani Kingdom, which has a strong male-dominated society. However, in shock when Kiriff breaks off the engagement, Chloe remembers her memories of her previous life as office worker Misa Tachibana!
Chloe, who has decided to leave everything behind and live freely, sets off in search of freedom with Erich, who has quit his position as a knight of the Kingsguard to take advantage of the commotion, as her partner!

title.native: 婚約破棄されたので、好きにすることにした。
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki Sareta node, Suki ni Suru Koto ni Shita

198036.description:
"Henteko Ikimono" are cute creatures with slightly unusual characteristics. There are characters that will heal you just by looking at them, such as "Naderyu", a dragon that is said to bring happiness when you stroke it, "Nekozame", a shark with a cute cat face, and "Mae-muki Kiwi", a kiwi that stays positive even after being cut off! There might be a "weird creature" right next to you...

(Source: Corocoro, translated)

198037.description:
For Sehyun and Yumi, taking sexy pictures was just a side gig. That is, until Hannah came into the picture...

(Source: Toomics)

198038.description:
This collection of phantom works features 11 chapters collected here for the first time, as well as Black Jack's final appearance drawn by Tezuka!

This volume contains 11 stories from the 67-chapter Midnight serialization in Weekly Shounen Champion from 1986 to 1987 that were never included in volume releases, plus three chapters featuring Black Jack in a crucial role in the final chapter. Presented in the same format as previous Rittorsha Tezuka publications: large B5 size matching the original format, high-definition printing, and valuable end-of-volume materials.

While Midnight is one of Tezuka's iconic late-career works, many fans have long eagerly awaited the volume release of its unpublished episodes, which remained unknown for 35 years since their initial publication. This volume is a phantom collection containing those 14 episodes, and it is also the last work Osamu Tezuka drew featuring Black Jack. Furthermore, the end-of-volume materials include original cover art for all 67 episodes, volume cover art, preview cuts, and existing manuscripts of Drive-R, the prototype for Midnight, along with commentary and explanations. This structure allows readers to fully enjoy the appeal of Midnight.

(Source: Rittorsha, translated)

title.native: ミッドナイト ロストエピソード

198039.description:
In the future, humanity has successfully left Earth and colonized various star systems, evolving into a new breed of humans who are taller and possess incredibly long lifespans. Meanwhile, Earth, the once-thriving mother planet, has been reduced to a nuclear wasteland due to over development and severe pollution. The original inhabitants still living on Earth now face an average lifespan of just 40 years, leading to widespread discrimination from the new humans. The protagonist is one of these Earth natives, but unlike others who have succumbed to despair, he works hard to become a mechanic even more skilled than the new humans. Just when he thought he could finally live a better life, he is met with betrayal and treated as cannon fodder when the cosmic insect race attacks a human outpost. However, with a burning desire for revenge, the protagonist discovers that he has been reborn as one of the cosmic insects!

(Source: iQIYIi, translated)
synonyms: My Clone Is the Space Bug King
蟲王転生〜地球人、虫になって宇宙を制す〜

title.romaji: Wo De Fenshen Shi Yuzhou Chong Wang

198040.description:
By a twist of fate, Roland is chosen to become an undercover agent, tasked with infiltrating the mysterious demon country to obtain critical intelligence. To stay hidden, he draws close to Bai Ling, a powerful and alluring fox demoness and ends up joining a faction made up entirely of seductive demonesses. As the only man in a world of monsters, temptation, and hidden danger, he walks a razor’s edge between predator and prey. Is he truly the one manipulating the game or is he being devoured by it?

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I’m an Undercover Agent in the Demon Nation
I Am an Undercover Agent in the Demon Country

title.english: I Am An Undercover Agent In The Demon Country
title.romaji: Wo Zai Yao Guo Dang Wodi

198041.description:
As the rainy season continues, a small rural village is shocked by murder cases that occur every rainy day. Witnesses say the suspect was so short that they were dragging a pickaxe. Rumors are spreading that the culprit might be a child... Who can the killer be?!

(Source: Toomics)

198042.description: Manga Anthology covering several of O. Henry's short stories.

title.native: オー・ヘンリー短編集

198043.description:
Based on the erotic game by ZION.

Clarice, the only princess in the elven kingdom of Eld, is also a shrine maiden who can predict the future through prophetic dreams, a tradition passed down through generations. But one day, she has an ominous dream in which the entire kingdom is swallowed up in darkness. She hurries to meet with her parents, the king and queen, who highly respect Clarice's abilities and believes that the country is in danger. However, he is puzzled by Clarice's theory that it is the Orc King's mass breeding campaign, a phenomenon that has been going on since the world's founding. And that night, Clarice's fears become reality, and an unprecedented threat approaches. A horde of orcs swarms the castle while the Royal Guard, led by Leona, a beautiful half-elf and Clarice's childhood friend, is away. Leona rushes to the castle after hearing the news and rescues Clarice just in time, but the Orc King, targeting her superior female body, pursues her relentlessly. After that, Clarice and her friends managed to escape to a neighboring country, even though many of their soldiers and attendants were killed by the orcs. However, that land was not safe either, and their pure bodies were violated...!!

(Source: Parabook, translated)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters (bad endings that are what-if scenarios from the first chapter) in the special digital edition.

title.native: 蹂躙王国ーエルフ王国は巨大苗床にー
title.romaji: Juurin Oukoku: Elf Oukoku wa Kyodai Naedoko ni

198045.description:
"I've always thought you were cute." Shinozuka Rei, who has difficulty expressing her emotions, is kept at a distance by those around her and even given the nickname "Noh Mask-san." Apart from Sasaki Nansho, who greets everyone cheerfully, she rarely speaks to anyone. One day, her boss invites her out to dinner, and she decides to go, thinking it's a chance to change herself, but she can't keep the conversation going and is subjected to harsh words. At that moment, Nansho, who called out to her, comes to her rescue...

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

title.native: 私のお面が取れるまで
title.romaji: Watashi no Omen ga Toreru Made

198047.description:
After losing all his possessions and sinking into deep depression, Today attempts suicide. Jimmy, who appears like an angel and saves his life, asks him to help him kill his own father, since he's going to throw his life away anyway. After hesitating, Today finally offers Jimmy a helping hand.

"Perhaps you're the savior who can help me start my life over again?"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: Today! I die วันนี้ผมขอตายครับ

198049.description:
Hye-Jun, a novelist struggling to sell, is disheartened by the poor performance of his published work when he teams up with Ethan, a popular YouTuber known for his promiscuity. Entering the filming set with preconceived notions, Hye-Jun discovers that Ethan, contrary to his reputation, is a genuinely kind person. He's helplessly thrilled by his affectionate behavior...

"Don't be nice to me. I'll just get the wrong impression."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

198050.description:
A murder occurs at the school where Professor Seo Jae-Ha works. The perpetrator disappears without a trace, and Seo Jae-Ha is suddenly kidnapped by Park In-Woo, a fellow student. Park In-Woo, the student and kidnapper, makes a mysterious offer to Seo Jae-ha...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

198051.description:
Manny, a member the Seven Sins gang and a secret informant for the police, loses his partner to a brutal serial killer. Before he can even process the shock, his boss assigns him a new partner - Sean, the one colleague he can’t stand. To make matters worse, his contact at the police asks him to dig into Sean’s past, suspecting he’s hiding something. With no choice but to get close, Manny turns to the method he knows best: seduction.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: HEAT WAVE: ヒートウェイブ

198052.description:
After losing his mother, Jun-Yeong was practically raised by his older step-brother, Jun-Won. Though once inseparable, their close bond fractured when Jun-Won hit adolescence, leaving them as distant as strangers. But during Jun-Yeong's final year of high school, everything abruptly shifts. The unspoken boundary between brothers suddenly begins to blur, turning a forgotten connection into a dark, obsessive desire where line crossing becomes unavoidable.

(Source: Lezhin US)

198054.description:
Leon Kierhi, the esteemed Commander of the Imperial Knights, renounces his title to pledge eternal loyalty to Prince Sienn. However, this devotion leads him into a harrowing nightmare when Prince Sonah uses a potent drug to erode Kierhi’s caution and pain, subjecting the upright knight to a series of degrading acts designed to shatter his pride. The betrayal reaches its peak as Sonah forces Kierhi to confront his lowest moment with Sienn, turning a sacred vow of service into a cruel cycle of trauma.

(Source: Tappytoon)

198055.description:
In Hwayeon Kingdom, there is a guardian god called 'Garden' that has served the king for generations. Legend has it that a king who is loved by the guardian god will live forever, so many kings long for the love of Garden. Bodyguard Black Young, who admires Garden, begins to gradually become greedy for it...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi, Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.

198056.description:
Tae-Hui, who lost her husband and runs a Chinese restaurant alone spends her days comforting her empty heart with pet toys. Then, she meets Seong-Chan, who was about to jump off the bridge her husband died from. Their chance encounter leads them to live together, but Tae-Hui finds herself drawn to Seong-Chan, who resembles her husband...

"I like you, sir, but do you really not like me?"

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note:
- Includes two extra chapters.
- 14th Mr. Blue Contest Short Story Winner.

198057.description:
Aspiring singer Kim Bo-Woo with a natural voice and a sense of composition, but an extreme inability to sing high notes, and the genius pianist Yoo Rae-In who comes to find him.

"I'll do whatever it takes to make you sing"

Suddenly opening the karaoke room door and hitting him, now telling him to take off his pants...

At this rate, other areas besides his vocal range will be compromised!!!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

198058.description:
When Kim Tae-Wun sneaks onto a film set to find his twin sister - an avid fan and fansite master of idol-turned-actor Lee Hae-Seo - he ends up running right into the star himself. The problem? Hae-Seo just happens to be in the middle of an uncontrollable rut cycle. In a whirlwind of chaos, Tae-Woon helps him through it, only to bolt like Cinderella at midnight. Now, with no idea who his mysterious savior was, Hae-Seo takes to social media to track him down… and Tae-Wun’s quiet life is about to get very, very noisy.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: LOVE ONENIGHT ：ラブ・ワンナイト

198059.description:
Calix Bastian, the empire’s one and only Grand Duke, harbors a secret obsession for Evan Chris, a low-ranking knight renowned for his beauty. One night, under the cover of a training drill, Calix sneaks into Evan’s room and is caught in the middle of a private act he cannot take back. Using that moment as leverage, the two begin meeting in secret, their bodies drawn together by desire. But for Calix, lust alone soon feels hollow. He wants something more, but how do you ask for love when all you've ever known is touch?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: เมื่อแกรนด์ดยุกพิชิตใจนายอัศวิน
To the grand duke who cannot ascend

198060.description:
When nobleman Lee Jung gets kicked out for defying his father's orders, he wanders until he meets the orphan Kwon Chan-Soo. Bewitched by Chan-Soo's resemblance to his first love, Jung finds himself drawn into Chan-Soo's world. But there's more to this orphan than meets the eye, and Jung is intrigued by the mysteries of it all. Will Jung figure out what he truly wants from life, or will Chan-Soo's many secrets trap him in a situation he can't escape from?

(Source: Lezhin US)

198061.description:
In his school days, Baek Kiho was an easy target, overweight, quiet, and even cursed with a name that classmates mocked as “Piggy Ho.” Years of relentless bullying drove him to drop out, leaving only scars and shame behind. But time changes everything. Kiho shed the weight, changed his name to Heeseong, and built a new life where no one could recognize the boy he once was. Then fate delivers an unexpected blow: his first love, Cheon Bokyeong, reappears. The very same Bokyeong who once despised him now approaches warmly, unable to connect Heeseong with the outcast she knew in the past. Torn between the longing he still feels and the terror of exposing his past, Heeseong hides the truth and lets their fragile relationship grow. But secrets have a way of surfacing and for Heeseong, the fear of losing both love and dignity weighs heavier than ever.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 3XLOVE：スリーエックスラージラブ

198062.description:
Jae-eun has one very specific type: hot, fit, nerdy guys. Too bad they’re as rare as shooting stars. Three years deep into single life, she’s focused on her studies until her totally transformed ex Hui-jun and her ideal type in the flesh, Seonwu, both walk back into her life. With Seonwu’s built chest and flawless nerd vibes, Jae-eun is instantly drawn in. But Hui-jun won’t stop hanging around, and after one of his provocations, Jae-eun blurts out that she’s dating Seonwu right in front of him. Flustered, she braces for disaster, but Seonwu surprises her with a calm reply:

"Didn't you say that because you have feelings for me too, Jae-eun?"

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 我就喜歡理工系帥哥，好嗎?!
The Hero Falls in Love with Villager A

title.native: 勇者は村人Aに恋をする

An Old Man with a Temper Tantrum and a Painter with a Windy Tongue: An Illustrated Scroll of a Journey to Measure Japan

His desire was to master the laws of motion of the earth, our home, in order to improve the calendar, an indispensable rule of life. Ino Tadataka, who measured Japan on foot and produced amazingly accurate maps during the Edo period. Then there is Kuu, a painter who lost his memory and moved into Ino's mansion.
