198144.description:
Mage Neoniah Ryan is hired to break the nightly curse afflicting Duke Syetry Demott Costas, a noble with dragon blood running through his veins. The plan works—until the cursed duke mistakes Neoniah for his mate. Trapped between spellwork, survival, and a monster’s instincts, Neoniah must end the curse before the night claims her...for good.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: How to Tame the Monster Duke

198145.description:
Jaeyeon has been in love with Nana ever since she started looking after him as a kid, but he’s always kept it a secret. One drunken slip-up finally exposes his feelings, turning playful teasing into something far more real. On a warm summer night, a one-sided crush spirals into a sweet, chaotic rom-com romance neither of them saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Sweeten the Deal: Believe in Love

198146.description:
Dex has a dangerous gift: with a single touch, he can read the memories of others. For the past thirty years, he’s been bound by a lifetime contract with the Hero Association, forced into service to cover up a mysterious incident. Now, the Association makes him an offer - if he can uncover the criminal past of the notorious villain Jin, suspected of recent terrorist attacks, they’ll finally set him free. Determined to return to the people he loves, Dex accepts. But to dig into Jin’s memories, there’s only one way forward: intimate contact that blurs the line between mission and desire. Will Dex succeed in his task? Or is he going after something impossible…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: サムシング・インポッシブル

198147.description:
Dandelion, the quirky, time-limited prince. He occasionally sees "a fragment of the future." Sometimes it's a crucial moment, sometimes a trivial one... but once he sees the future, it inevitably becomes reality. One day, at a party, he meets Kelewen, the high elf who will save the world—and that fragment unfolds before his eyes.

"Tell him you won't leave, Leon."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: To You Who Will Die Alone in Paradise

198148.description: Is she real or an illusion? Maria is called a witch, and quietly watches the everyday lives of humans from a god’s point of view. At times she appears as a character in a story, and at times she guides the story. Is she alive or dead? What is the witch Maria…?

198149.description:
Three years ago, Tae-Yang’s boyfriend ended their relationship by announcing his engagement to someone else. Tae-Yang never expected to cross paths with him again, yet while investigating suspicious rumors surrounding the couple, the journalist suddenly finds himself face to face with his ex, Woo Ju-Yeol. Ju-Yeol offers Tae-Yang exclusive information for his reports, but the price is unsettling: Tae-Yang must be at his beck and call for sex, no questions asked.. Determined to expose Ju-Yeol’s darkest secrets, Tae-Yang accepts the deal. What begins as a transaction soon spirals into a dangerous mix of obsession, desire, and revenge.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: SCOOP สกู๊ปฉาวของคุณนักข่าวกับท่านประธาน
SCOOP！〜特ダネという名の甘い罠〜

198150.description: Based on the adventure novel "Deux ans de vacances" by Jules Gabriel Verne released in 1888.

198151.description:
Noishe, a count's daughter who was Japanese in her previous life, has a dream. That is to live a quiet, unassuming life. However, it seems that a flag has been raised with Charles, the son of a prestigious duke whom she meets at a ball... Why? Does the fact that she doesn't fall for the high-spec, sparkling duke's son mean that he thinks she's "interesting"? This is a typical flag from a shoujo manga that I want to break with all my might! And yet, I messed up. I accidentally revealed that I had a previous life. Since then, he's been courting me with great enthusiasm... I never thought he'd be so dog-like! A love comedy set in another world, between two aristocrats, Japanese in their previous lives☆

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: メルディオン公爵家の若夫婦は少し変わっている。
title.romaji: Meldion Koushakuke no Waka Fuufu wa Sukoshi Kawatteiru.

198152.description:
A spin-off of the hugely popular Ginga Densetsu series! Familiar characters from the Ginga series, led by the usually cool but secretly passionate John, appear one after another! Cute yet strong men fight for their master in this slapstick neighborhood watchdog battle comedy!

(Source: Gorakuweb, translated)
synonyms: Legend of Silver Fang Spin-off! Guard Dog John!!

title.native: 銀牙伝説外伝番犬ジョン！

198153.description:
"If you can't do it, just eat it."

"...You can do it. Just do it."

At twenty, the first adult night of their lives. To celebrate becoming adults, Jeong-Wook, Seung-Woo, and Woo-Hyuk rent a pension and spend the night drinking. Seung-Woo and Woo-Hyuk exchange meaningful glances and suggest a drinking game, and Jeong-Wook casually agrees. However, the moment the first video plays—the man in Yeong-Sang is masturbating through his asshole.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: The Bottle Is Down, Not Up

198155.description:
Kang Hyo-in has been secretly in love with his best friend of eight years, Jin Ye-geon, nd he’s finally ready to turn that crush into something more. Armed with a meticulous plan to win Ye-geon’s heart, Hyo-in is determined to confess the “right” way. But one drunken night he can’t even remember throws everything off track, and suddenly they’re dating before he can make sense of what happened. Now there’s just one burning question he can’t ignore: what exactly did they do… and which one of them ended up on the bottom?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.
synonyms: 結局どっちが上だったの？
ตกลงใครเป็นรับกันแน่?

title.native: 俺の幼馴染がデッッッッかくなりすぎた
title.romaji: Ore no Osananajimi ga Dekkkkkaku Narisugita

198157.description:
Seven years have passed since the all-out war between demons and mankind. Three elf siblings call a peaceful village home, and what should appear before them but a survivor of the demon race--an orc!! In a panic, the younger sister, adventurer Alicia, draws her sword, but the orc is cradling a human child... The orc begs the elves, his enemies, to "please save this child"?!

(Source: emaqi)

title.native: 俺の幼馴染がデッッッッかくなりすぎた
title.romaji: Ore no Osananajimi ga Dekkkkkaku Narisugita

title.native: 神聖騎士ディアンナの贖罪

198160.description:
Rumor has it there’s corrupt guildmaster who keeps banishing his members one after another. That "tyrant" is Act Enge—the founder and leader of the rising S-rank guild, Heaven’s Gem. Having once suffered a wrongful expulsion himself, Act refuses to cast anyone out without careful thought... and every person he banishes ends up landing an even better position!

Surrounded by a cool-but-puppy-like maid, a tomboy princess, an absurdly strong hero, and a whole roster of eccentric allies who trust him deeply, this "corrupt" guildmaster just can’t stop finding, fostering, and banishing people!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: The Corrupt Guildmaster Is Beloved by the Banished
title.native: 俺は冒険者ギルドの悪徳ギルドマスター ～人材を適材適所に追放したら、なぜかめちゃくちゃ感謝されました～
title.romaji: Ore wa Boukensha Guild no Akutoku Guild Master: Jinzai wo Tekizai Tekisho ni Tsuihou shitara, Naze ka Mechakucha Kansha Saremashita

title.native: 大学生の俺、黒ギャル美女管理人さん（35）の激しい杭打ち騎乗位でナマ中出ししちゃいました
title.romaji: Daigakusei no Ore, Kuro Gal Bijo Kanrinin-san (35) no Hageshii Kuiuchi Kijoui de Namanakadashi Shichaimashita

198162.description:
I think I'll have a quick taste... of your score...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2018-11

title.native: インラン生徒会長のヒミツ

198166.description:
A twisted form of lovemaking carved into her body.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in COMIC BAVEL 2023-12

title.native: 先生！注射のお時間です

198169.description: Otaka Kakuto, a high school boy with a congenital heart condition, moves to Hokkaido to recuperate with his twin sister Katsumi. Kokuto has become friendly with his classmates, but one incident with a monster in the woods triggers a major change in his mind and body. In order to protect his beloved sister (Kokuto), he transcends all restrictions. Here comes the devil in human skin, the masked man!

198170.description:
Naoto Suzuki, goes to work on the first train and returns home on the last train, repeating the same boring routine. One day before work, he ordered a breakfast set meal at a beef bowl restaurant in Kabukicho as usual, but he met a cheerful host who was on his way home. This is a morning routine story that depicts the 15 minutes of these two opposites overlap!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

198172.description: Note: Published in COMIC Shigekiteki SQUIRT!! Vol. 62, 63

title.native: カヤ姉とジジイの思い出

198173.description: Note: Published in COMIC Shigekiteki SQUIRT!! Vol. 63

198174.description: Note: Published in COMIC Shigekiteki SQUIRT!! Vol. 63

198175.description: Note: Published in COMIC Shigekiteki SQUIRT!! Vol. 63

198176.description: Note: Published in COMIC Shigekiteki SQUIRT!! Vol. 63

title.native: 押しに弱い爆乳奥さん

198177.description:
At this school, there is a certain system that is passed around among the students.

Created about ten years ago, it is a “school-only support matchmaking bulletin board” that connects boys and girls looking for paid encounters.

Through a connection with a senior student, I (Ooshima) happened to learn about its existence. Following his advice, I arranged a meeting through the bulletin board and headed to the designated meeting place.

But the person waiting for me there was none other than Okigawa, a delinquent “kuro gyaru” girl!?

Honestly, I just can’t imagine doing anything erotic with Okigawa...

Note:This is an alternate version of the popular CG series "Gakuen Suppo Nikki" by the same author, released through his doujin circle, B.B.T.T.

title.native: なりたてＪＣ初めての援交

198180.description:
Our bias got married!

What's the next big thing for these former groupies? Perhaps it's time for them to chase down... the perfect marriage partner?!

When the actor they had dedicated their lives to announces his marriage, four young women (and former groupies) call an emergency meeting. A panicked Chikako, 34-years-old and the eldest of the group, announces to everyone that she absolutely will find a partner and be married within one year. Her secret weapon? Online dating! These women are giving up on the race to snag concert tickets and stepping onto the battlefield of love and dating. (sentence).

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: You can put on the glass shoes, even if it's broken.

title.english: The Glass Slipper Fits, So Who Cares if It's Chipped?
title.native: ガラスの靴は割れてもはける
title.romaji: Glass no Kutsu wa Waretemo Hakeru

198181.description:
"Humans in this country don't take sleep seriously enough." This is a story about work -- that is, an office worker in her late twenties and her sleep demon, whose job it is to get her to sleep! Yoko is a hard worker, that's for sure. She's missed her last train home yet again and feels herself losing the battle to sleep in the bathroom. That's when she senses a shadow over her shoulder. She turns around only to find -- a sleep demon?! "Oh. You can see me." says Nero, a regular old office worker at Sleep Demons Incorporated in the Underworld. His monthly salary comes from getting humans go to sleep, and from today, he's in charge of Yoko. Thus begins Yoko and Nero's daily quest to improve her quality of sleep -- for both of their sakes!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

198182.description:
Growing up with a silver spoon, Rosa has lived a flawless life as the perfect modern-day princess. She’s always gotten everything she wanted - except for one thing: Kim Yeonwoo, the boy from the orphanage who once slipped through her fingers.Ten years later, starved for something to stir her restless heart, Rosa finally sees Yeonwoo again. But there’s just one problem...he’s now the man by her mother’s side. Though she knows it’s a dangerous love she can never have, Rosa can’t resist toying with her new father-to-be, both in body and in mind…

(Source: Lezhin US)

198183.description:
Nestled within the quiet residential streets near a subway station is a bustling hub teeming with office workers, ""Paradise Villa."" From the dimly lit semi-basement units to the fourth floor where the landlord resides, the tenants living here appear ordinary at a glance. However, sharing a building is the only thing they truly have in common. Their professions, personal relationships, and even their darkest sexual preferences couldn't be more distinct.

Behind these closed doors lies a volatile mix of modern secrets, featuring everyone from desperate car-poor youth and frustrated sexless couples to secretive cohabiting lovers. As the suffocating pressures of their daily grinds collide with the privacy of their apartments, the thin veneer of normalcy begins to crack. In this hidden sanctuary, their repressed inhibitions break free, letting their overflowing, raw desires take complete control.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

198189.description:
Even though high school student Arima Shougo is truly terrified of anything eerie, because he can see ghosts he was forced to join the "Occult Research Club". In an unexpected turn of events, he encounters the ghost of Yoshizawa Takumi, an underclassman who is rumoured to have committed suicide. Arima helps fulfill Yoshizawa's only wish that keeps him lingering with regret. While doing so, Yoshizawa's kind and gentle personality underneath his calm and collected expression slowly captivates Arima. What will happen on the final day that Arima fulfills that wish completely...?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: I'm the only one who knows

title.native: セイントヒップピーチ

198192.description:
Mozuno Futoshi is a small, weak-willed boy who has the unfortunate "prey nature" of being harassed by delinquents and falling into open manholes in his daily life. But then, a dark-skinned gal named Cacao appears before him, clearly a bubbly girl who is the polar opposite of him. With her uniform loosened, her breasts overflowing, and for some reason, her abs, she catches Mozuno's eye and calls him "Prey" and makes him the target of her "hunt"...!?

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

synonyms: I'm in love with you, my love

198194.description:
"The job is simple. You just have to be a dog."

When his father's company went bankrupt, Dale Jackson was in debt. As he wanders helplessly in the midst of the Great Depression, a strange proposal comes to him. Unable to pass up the opportunity to work for the Baskervilles, the richest man in New York, Dale finally accepts the offer.

198195.description:
She was forced to marry. Now, her husband wants a divorce. Leah retreats to a secluded villa to regroup—only to be saved from danger by a mysterious leopard. But the wild creature is no ordinary beast; he’s Januk, a shape-shifting imperial prince, and taming him might be the start of something wild.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: 意外被救后，驯服了猫系皇子
野獣な皇太子を手懐ける方法

198196.description:
To avenge the murder of her sister, Theadora Calyx goes to war with Dorzen, a rival empire. But when a divine error kills Theadora, she awakens to find her sworn enemy, Theodore Dorzen, smitten with her, and her sister still alive! With a new divine power to stop time, can Theadora rewrite history?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I Tamed the Crown Prince of the Enemy Nation

198197.description:
It’s bad enough that Team Leader Jeong-Hyun Baek has a thing for his omega subordinate, but when that subordinate is all tangled up with Jeong-Hyun’s beta boss? This love affair can’t possibly end well…

(Source: Tapas)

198199.description:
Delivery driver Kang Han-Gil has spent every waking moment trying to save his father, who has turned into a zombie. Poverty and exhaustion weigh on him, but he refuses to give up. Then someone from his past reappears, Shin Mi-Dum, a man Han-Gil hoped never to see again. Calling himself a “zombie caretaker,” Mi-Dum claims he can cure Han-Gil’s father with a new experimental drug. But there is a price, and his demand is unsettlingly simple, he wants Han-Gil in his bed. Before Han-Gil can decide whether to accept, disaster strikes. His zombified father escapes, the apartment complex collapses into chaos, and the entire building becomes a nest of the undead. Trapped together, Han-Gil and Mi-Dum have no choice but to rely on each other.

With personal grudges simmering and survival on the line, can these two men escape the nightmare closing in on all sides, or will the past consume them before the zombies do?

(Source: Lezhin US)

198200.description:
Jeong Hae-Deun, a former high school competitive swimmer, now lives a quiet life working at a local swim center. His world is upended when Han Si-O appears, spinning a desperate web of lies about a career-ending leg injury that supposedly prevents him from ever swimming again. Moved by pity and a shared history, Hae-Deun falls for the deception and allows Si-O to move into his home.

However, Si-O’s motives are far from innocent. Having harbored a dark, obsessive crush on Hae-Deun for years, he views this cohabitation as the ultimate opportunity. Si-O relentlessly pushes boundaries, his subtle manipulations eventually giving way to raw, unfiltered lust. He no longer hides his true nature, whispering feverish, provocative desires to his senior: "I want to spend all day tangled with you, kissing you... I want to sink into you and fill your inside with nothing but me."

(Source: Lezhin US)

198201.description:
Baek Ji-Hwan is used to being alone. Gay, kinky, and unapologetically himself, he never fit anywhere easily. When Seo Jae-Rim enters his life, Ji-Hwan thinks he’s finally found the perfect partner. Until the truth comes out: Jae-Rim is straight, has a girlfriend, and wants Ji-Hwan’s help learning BDSM for her sake. Ji-Hwan rejects him immediately, but Jae-Rim keeps coming back.

Unseen by everyone else, Jae-Rim becomes the one presence Ji-Hwan can’t ignore… his invisible partner.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

198202.description:
Cha Yun-Ho can’t shake the feeling that a suspicious man in sunglasses is following him, shameless eyes glued to his bodacious backside. Just as Yun-Ho tries to get away, the man suddenly makes an outrageous offer. He wants Yun-Ho to become the model for his brand. To Yun-Ho’s shock, the stranger turns out to be Kwon Wu-Hyeok, his first love from fourteen years ago. Before he knows it, Yun-Ho finds himself working at what might be the best job imaginable, spending all day with Wu-Hyeok. There’s just one problem: Wu-Hyeok’s brand’s clothing is a little short, tight, and triangular for Yun-Ho’s liking…

(Source: Lezhin US)

198203.description:
With her followers decimated by other churches, Granchia, the goddess of rightful revenge, is on the brink of destruction. Restricted and bound to human form, she must protect and support her one last true believer...or cease to exist. Can she find a way to gather her servants and muster enough power to avenge the wrongs done to her believer and his family? Or will her enemies succeed in their mission to destroy her last follower, dooming her to oblivion?

(Source: Tapas)

198204.description: Note: Published in COMIC Kairakuten XTC Vol. 1

title.native: テスト中もイかせてッ!

198205.description:
Notes:
• An extra chapter is included
• A live-action AV adaptation (MIMK-247) was released on October 7th, 2025.

198206.description:
Shun Hayakawa is a second-year university student. His problem is... premature ejaculation!! He musters up his courage and visits a clinic that specializes in curing premature ejaculation. To his surprise, the doctor there is a stunningly beautiful woman with big breasts...!! What is the naughty treatment the doctor recommends...? As he continues to visit the clinic, the relationship between the boy and the doctor gradually escalates... Will he be able to cure his premature ejaculation?

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MIMK-200) was released on July 15th, 2025.

198207.description:
For nineteen years, Wel stood as the Holy Sword Hero, defending the Kingdom of Klenrad from monstrous threats. With just one year left before his retirement, betrayal struck from the shadows. Framed by the royal princesses, he was branded a criminal and exiled from the kingdom he bled to protect.

Stripped of his name and honor, Wel vanished beyond the borders of mankind—into the lands of the demonfolk. There, he was taken in by Natalia, a fierce warrior of the Oni Tribe, and her daughter, Delilah. Wel began a new chapter among the demonkind, gradually finding peace as he built a quiet life in their village.

As bonds grew between him, Natalia, and Delilah, the former hero who once stood at the forefront of war now embraced a life of warmth, healing… and the calm before whatever storm might come next.
synonyms: Exiled Hero Picked up by a Demon

title.native: 国に捨てられた烙印勇者、幼女に拾われて幸せなスローライフを始める
title.romaji: Kuni ni Suterareta Rakuin Yuusha, Youjo ni Hirowarete Shiawasena Slow Life wo Hajimeru

198208.description: Note: Originally published in ihr HertZ September 2017 issue, later reprinted in iHZ royal.6 in celebration of the drama adaptation.

title.native: 被写界深度 #0 ボーイミーツボーイ

198209.description: Note: Chapter 1 was split into two parts in the original serialization.

198210.description:
Tama, a human raised by a pack of wolves who can transform into humans, is closer to the wolves than he is to humans. He lives a happy life with his wolf childhood friend, Tatsu. Tatsu worked hard to learn how to transform into his human form in order to be with his beloved Tama. Now a proper, responsible adult, it is Tatsu’s turn to take over the pack. But one rainy day, Tatsu pushes Tama down and makes a bold claim. “Now, I can have children with you, Tama.” Tama always saw Tatsu as a brother...but what is this intense beating in his chest?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

198211.description:
Lee Gi-Joo, sick and tired of his miserable outcast life, realizes he needs a girlfriend to escape it. But the girl he falls for at first sight just happens to be the daughter of a boxing gym owner. While trying to turn his life around by getting a girlfriend, Gi-Joo instead starts to fall for the true charm of boxing in the ring.

“Endurance doesn’t just come naturally!”

The story of an outcast fighting for a life turnaround through boxing!

(Source: Naver, translated)

198212.description:
Thanks to his tenacity, college student Rio has just landed himself his first boyfriend: the suave and mature club bartender, Chiaki. But while Rio obsesses over his mega hot "Mr. Perfect," he also begins to worry he might not be good enough for him. Then, when Chiaki gets the idea that Rio wants to break up, he suddenly grows desperate. Turns out Rio's new boyfriend is actually quite (endearingly) clingy!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Notes:
- Originally published as a two-part story and later picked up for serialization under the title "Hatsu Kare Double-Sided (初彼ダブルサイデッド)".
- Includes the one-shot "Renai Antithese (恋愛アンチテーゼ)" and one extra chapter.
198212.hashtag: #初彼ダブルサイデッド #俺以外にはときめかないで
synonyms: 初彼ダブルサイデッド

title.english: Don't Let Anyone But Me Make Your Heart Race
title.native: 俺以外にはときめかないで

198215.description:
"I clearly love you... but why is this happening?"

Ara, struggling with boredom, finds herself with her lover, Kang-Woo, and they're no longer the same. Her friends offer her some heartwarming advice... and Ara's heart starts to race.

"If this is it, I'll definitely be back to how I was before!"

With this hope in her heart, Ara secretly calls out to Kang-Woo...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

198216.description:
At 31, neither work nor love is easy! Marriage is looming, but it's also an age where having fun is more important than anything else. So, three friends gathered together. They were close friends, hiding nothing from each other. But... it seems like they've started hiding something lately. This is the secret love story of three close friends who know everything about each other's beds.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

198217.description:
Jae-Han, a once promising newcomer webtoon artist, has found his path to adult BL (black and white) a long and arduous one. With his self-esteem plummeting from repeated failures, one day, swept up in the atmosphere, he ends up kissing Jun-Woo, the boy next door. What Jae-Han initially thought was nothing special, a simple kiss, unleashes a powerful narrative arc. Their relationship, in which they engage in repeated physical contact despite not being lovers, spirals into a delicate spiral, but the arrival of a new producer throws things into a new direction...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

198218.description:
Kyung has grown distant from Ji-Woo, who he's been close with since high school, but they end up taking the same class at the same university! He wants to know why he's keeping his distance, but Ji-Woo won't say anything. On top of that, he meets some beggarly group members who just fare evasion, and his grades are seriously failing. Damn it. Should he take a leave of absence? Kyung returns home, visibly annoyed, and heads to the bathroom when he suddenly sees Ji-Woo popping out of the mirror.

What the? Why are you coming out of there? Why are you sucking my XX?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

198219.description:
Yeong-Ha is a talented practitioner of traditional Korean medicine, but ever since word got out that he’s an omega, business has been at an all-time low. Meanwhile, his teenage neighbor, Pureum, is also struggling to stay afloat in the midst of college entrance exams… and a devastating crush on his hot, older neighbor. But after one of Yeong-Ha’s energy-boosting tonics turns Pureum from a beta into an alpha, the doctor will have to take responsibility for this medical miracle… in ways he never imagined.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: My Alpha Era Began After Taking Gongjin-dan
His Time as an Alpha Began After Eating Gongjin-dan

title.native: 공진단 먹고 나의 알파 시대 시작됐다
title.romaji: Gongjindan Meokgo Naui Alpha Sidae Sijakdwaetda

198221.description: Once the closest of lovers, Ji Lingyue and Lan Wu, were forced apart by their identities as human and demon. Lan Wu, the mermaid princess, chose to leave Ji Lingyue, subjecting her to countless days and nights of agony. When they reunited at a cultivation gathering, Ji Lingyue swore never to let Lan Wu leave again.

198222.description: Riley, a wandering artist disguised as a maid, gets caught stealing at Hilland Manor. As guards whip her, the lady of the manor, Yasmin, unexpectedly shields her. Riley couldn’t believe her luck at the noble’s kindness until Yasmin tended her wounds and revealed hidden desires and schemes. This "rescue" was a trap all along!

198223.description:
Astraea, the strongest swordswoman in the world. One day, she realizes that she has reincarnated as a character inside a novel. And that role is the one who gets killed by the Evil God, the final boss...

During a mountain hike, she saves a child from assailants, only to learn that this very child is destined to become the Evil God.

"Well then, since it’s come to this, how about I raise him properly and reform him?"

So she takes the child in and begins to raise him. But then...

"Rea. Where are you going? Are you meeting that guy again?"

The boy has grown into an obsessive man who follows her everywhere, watching her every move. Somehow... it feels like she raised him the wrong way.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: I Raised the Seed of Evil
悪の種を育ててしまった

198224.description:
Fifteen-year-old Go Young-Hui, buried in books, believes human relationships are a disaster. The words "family" and "lover" simply send shivers down her spine. Filled with thoughts and worries, Go Young-Hui is confronted by the appearance of Kim Kang-Ah, a girl from her class who confesses her love and says, "I like you." And then, by a twist of fate, they have to live together... She finds herself in the middle of a dilemma. Mom, Dad, Kang-Ah, the uncle, the kids at school, everyone on this earth. She resents whether anyone even thinks. The greatest crisis of her life strikes during adolescence. With a sad face, she closes her book and runs into the real world. What answer will she find at the end of her long reflection?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

198225.description:
Rejected by her family and betrayed by her fiancé and scheming half-sister, Efna gets a second chance at life when she wakes up before the accident that was meant to end her. Determined to live quietly as a teacher, she soon discovers that her mischievous Sunshine Class is only the beginning. Add a few politically feuding older brothers into the mix—a dashing captain, an emperor, and an archduke—and chaos is inevitable. Can Efna make it through nap time, or will she lose her sanity first?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Teacher of the Nobles’ Kindergarten Is Having a Hard Day Again
Another Grueling Day for the Aristocratic Kindergarten Teacher
The Teacher at the Noble Kindergarten Is Having a Hard Time Again Today

198226.description:
For 10 years, Pyung-Hwa Gong and Sae-Byuk Shin have kept their love a secret from family and friends. But then, the alpha and omega pair invite their old classmates to their daughter's first birthday party, ready to reveal their unbelievable love story. Strap in for the romance of a lifetime!

(Source: Manta)

198227.description:
Yuuta and Ren have been best friends since grade school. In fact, Maki, Yuuta's mom, was a mother figure to Ren as he grew up. But now that he's an adult, those feelings have morphed into something else. And with Maki looking as young as beautiful as ever, Ren is finding it harder and harder not to make a move on her...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Released at Comiket 105

title.english: Learning About Sex From My Friend's Mom
title.native: 初恋の爆乳友ママが やさしく性の手ほどきをしてくれる話
title.romaji: Hatsukoi no Bakunyuu Tomo Mama ga Yasashiku Sei no Tehodoki wo Shitekureru Hanashi

198228.description:
Killed by her most trusted comrade, Assassin Agent Black is reborn as the baby princess of a historical novel. Immediately, she faces repeated assassination attempts and is even forsaken by the king when he refuses to give her a name, but she won't let anyone get her this time. As she uses her assassin skills to survive, she starts making allies, saves the prince's life, and even catches the king's interest. But with a target still on her, will that be enough to keep this little princess alive?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Was Reincarnated as the Spoiled Baby Empress
I Was Reincarnated as the Abandoned Baby Princess

title.english: Reborn as the Forsaken Baby Princess

198229.description:
It’s Juliet Monad’s birthday, and she has only one wish—for the coldhearted Duke Lenox Carlyle to break up with her. When the infamously promiscuous duke refuses to let her go, Juliet takes matters into her own hands and leaves under the guise of illusion magic. Haunted by memories of a past life, Juliet is desperate for a way to escape a tragic fate. But the nature of magic isn’t always benevolent, and time isn’t on her side. Does Juliet have no choice but to rely on Duke Carlyle?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ジュリエットが消えた夜

198230.description:
One day, a UFO appeared in the sky and abducted us. We were brought back to Earth, somehow altered. From that day on, we began seeing strange things: unknown numbers, coordinates, and red dots. What do they mean? What kind of alteration have we undergone?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

198231.description:
Kim Ha-Kyung, a model student who is preparing for her college entrance exams this year, was initially skeptical of dating after hearing that dating would lead to ruin. However, she falls in love at first sight with Han Seung-Baek. However, Han Seung-Baek has a reputation as a troubled kid, and Kim Ha-Kyung becomes entangled in many situations afterward. To make matters worse, her childhood friend Kwon Gu-Min also expresses his feelings for her...

Will Kim Ha-Kyung, who has embarked on a relationship that adults discourage, be able to grasp both love and reality?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

198232.description:
The crazy princess and the barbarian of the North... Some would call it a perfect match, but neither is truly what they seem: Chloe was only branded as insane by her stepmother as part of a plan to assassinate her, and Callios is a fallen prince who cares deeply for his people. Chloe may have succumbed to her stepmother's schemes in her first life, but this time, she's determined to take revenge with the perfect ally at her side! Can these two make the empire pay for destroying their families?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: If I Don’t Get Married I’ll Die
I’ll Die If I Don’t Get Married

198233.description:
Moran Street in Manwol-dong, one of the villages where goblins coexist. An unexpected new family moves in. The story begins and continues as the goblins of Manwolsan, the residents of Moran, and the new family meet.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title.native: 陰キャだった僕が噂のアプリで魔改造したら美女を食えましたw
title.romaji: Inkya Datta Boku ga Uwa sa no Appli de ma Kaizou Shitara Bijo wo Kuemashita w

title.native: アイドルの私があいつのセフレになった日
title.romaji: Idol no Watashi ga Aitsu no Sex Friend ni Natta Hi

198236.description:
Is this "shepherd" out of the ordinary?! Alto, the third son of a noble family whose territory is the ruins of the Demon King's castle, got the job of "shepherd" when he turned 10 years old. "Shepherd" is said to be a weak job that is difficult to level up. One day, Alto picked up and saved a small dog in the Demon King's castle that he was cultivating. From the day he saved it without realizing that it was a legendary monster, Alto's level as a "shepherd" rose at an explosive rate! A "frontier gourmet fantasy" brought to you by the hidden strongest "shepherd" and the legendary sheep-herding monster.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 昔滅びた魔王城で拾った犬は、実は伝説の魔獣でした ～隠れ最強職《羊飼い》な貴族の三男坊、いずれ、百魔獣の王となる～
title.romaji: Mukashi Horobita Maoujou de Hirotta Inu wa, Jitsu wa Densetsu no Majuu Deshita: Kakure Saikyoushoku "Hitsujikai" na Kizoku no Sannanbou, Izure, Hyaku Majuu no Ou to Naru

198238.description:
Don’t settle. Fight for your dreams!

Dong-Man dreamed of becoming a national taekwondo athlete. Aera wanted to become a successful news anchor. But who has time for childhood aspirations when there are bills to be paid? Follow Dong-Man and Aera in their fight to find love and success within the harsh realities of life.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: サム、マイウェイ～恋の一発逆転!～

198239.description:
Nelly once believed love meant sacrifice. She donated her kidney to support her husband Ron's dreams, only to be repaid with betrayal and heartbreak. After her tragic death, she awakens ten years in the past, moments before signing away her future. Faced with the same choice, she finally understands her worth and refuses to sacrifice herself again. As she steps away from Ron, an encounter with Ivan, Ron’s uncle, changes the course of her story. Revenge may have brought her back, but love may complicate things.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: After Refusing to Donate a Kidney, I Became My Ex's Little Aunt
From Refusing to Donate a Kidney to Became My Ex's Young Aunt

title.english: Meet My Ex Again As His Aunt
title.native: 拒绝捐肾，我成了前任的小舅妈
title.romaji: Jujue Juan Shen, Wo Chengle Qianren De Xiao Jiuma

198240.description:
Lin Yuxi thought Zhou Yanjing loved her, but in the end, she realized it was just a self-deceptive joke. The one he truly loved had always been someone else. When their three-year marriage contract ended, she took off her wedding ring and chose not to linger. Everyone believed their divorce was inevitable. However, instead of hearing news of their separation, people were shocked to witness the aloof and untouchable Young Master Zhou kneeling before a woman, his voice hoarse as he pleaded: "Lin Yuxi, can you love me one more time?"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Kimi no Subete wo Kowasu made

198244.description:
Prince of Destruction Zegard, destined to annihilate the world, arrives in a Japanese village with his maid Milky. An unforgiving massacre is about to begin...!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: The Descent of Zegard, Prince of Destruction
title.native: 破壊王子ゼガルドの集落降臨
title.romaji: Hakai Ouji Zegard no Shuuraku Kourin

198245.description:
Ebisawa, who plays guitar and sings in a band, was inspired by Shake's guitar playing and singing in "The Salmons." Determined not to lose, he pushed himself harder. Though his efforts paid off and Ebisawa gained popularity, the seemingly unbridgeable gap between himself and Shake eventually broke his spirit...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

198246.description:
Theodore thought he was on a beach vacation with his friends, but instead he wakes up in an unfamiliar room. Confused, he turns to the stranger sleeping beside him, a young man named Luca. Luca explains that he saw Theodore being kidnapped and was taken along with him. They try to escape, but the harsh wilderness blocks their way, leaving them confined in an abandoned, isolated motel. An orphan and the son of a wealthy family, though they come from different worlds, in the tense situation they find comfort only in each other and gradually grow closer. But their encounter was no accident, it was part of a plan for revenge...

(Source: Julian Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

198247.description:
Life at a ramen shop is never dull! Owan runs the neighborhood ramen spot called "Power Bomb." Just as she was praying for some hungry hero to save her struggling business, in walks...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: おわんちゃんの波瀾万丈麺

198248.description:
Notes:
- Original serialization ran for 10 chapters. In the volume release, Chapters 4 to 6 were combined as Chapter 4 and Chapters 7 to 9 were combined as Chapter 5.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ラヴァー・ストリッパー

198249.description:
Cover Illustration: Choco Sable
1. Naki no Hito Koe (鳴きのひとこえ) [Nobutaro]
2. Coffee wo Motsu Te mo (コーヒーを持つ手も) [Nashida]
3. Atatakai Meshi Ki no Mukougawa (あたたかい飯気のむこう側) [Yoshiharu Shiba]
4. Asa, Kimi to Engawa de. (朝、君と縁側で。) [Koma Suzuku]
5. COFFEE AND DONUTS [Niaoski]
6. Koufuku no Aji (幸福の味) [Atsuage]
7. Kuu Neru Tokoro ni Sumu Tokoro(食う寝るところに住むところ) [Youji]
8. go-to [Yoshihisa Komeda]
synonyms: Shall We Have Breakfast?: Oneshot Anthology

title.native: 読み切りアンソロジー『朝食、しましょうか。』
ブルーイルドープキス

198251.description:
A prickly-type guy, Koharu Hachiya, from a venture interior design company, and a big-dog-type guy, Yamato Kumada, from a major furniture manufacturer. These two interior coordinator trainees, complete opposites in personality and appearance, end up living together under the same roof…!

“We’ll make your room wonderful!”

An interior design workplace BL — a new life begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: メイク・ディア・ホーム

198252.description:
Ji-Hun Seo is a civil servant who wants nothing more than a peaceful, easy life. But after an angry complainant stabs him, he wakes up in the Murim, a world ruled by martial arts. Reborn as Ilmok, he quickly settles into a quiet job at a local inn, only for the Heavenly Demon to appear and force him to become his disciple. Now surrounded by deadly martial artists and even deadlier training, can Ilmok survive the Demonic Cult without sacrificing the one thing he values most: a healthy work-life balance?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Forced To Become The Heavenly Demon At Swordpoint
Threatened Into Becoming the Heavenly Demon

title.english: Forced to Be the Heavenly Demon

198253.description:
A crushing defeat in middle school drove Gang-Hwi away from basketball. Even as a freshman at Jeon-gwang High, famous for its explosive run-and-gun style, he wants nothing to do with the game. Instead, he channels his competitive drive into one-upping Ilrok, his towering freshman rival. But when their fierce rivalry leads to a one-on-one on the basketball court, Gang-Hwi’s spectacular ankle breaker changes everything, with the varsity coach calling him the missing piece for a national championship run. Can the undersized speedster be the key to championship glory?

(Source: WEBTOON)

198254.hashtag: #最近幼なじみの様子がおかしい

title.native: 最近幼なじみの様子がおかしい。
title.romaji: Saikin Osananajimi no Yousu ga Okashii.

198255.description:
Eunho is on the verge of receiving an academic warning due to Seoyoung, his childhood friend's, excessive pranks. Facing the threat of losing his allowance and tuition, Eunho decides to operate a (fake) couple YouTube channel with Seoyoung to earn money. Their first content: 'What happens when you spend a night with your female friend'! They fall asleep together, insisting nothing will happen... but...

“Since it's come to this, should we…?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

synonyms: The knight who lost his skills and me

title.native: スキルをなくした騎士様と俺
title.romaji: Skill wo Nakushita Kishi-sama to Ore

198257.description: Note: Published in Monthly Big Gangan No. 9, 2025.

198258.description:
Because her mother was a slave, Erendira was oppressed despite being a member of royalty. She was brutally bullied by her half-brothers and sisters, eventually losing her life. However, at the moment of death, memories of her previous life as a Japanese person came back to her! Erendira sought revenge. However, her fate changed when the neighboring country of Agdnigur invaded. What awaited her as she tried to survive using her knowledge of "cooking" from her previous life... A Cinderella story of reincarnation into another world, where she is loved from all sides!

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

title.native: 千夜千食物語　〜敗国の姫ですが氷の皇子殿下がどうも溺愛してくれています〜
title.romaji: Senya Senshoku Monogatari: Haikoku no Hime desu ga Koori no Ouji Denka ga Doumo Dekiai Shite Kureteimasu

198259.description:
Betrayal and false accusation lead to a contract marriage between a doting assassin and a falsely accused young lady!? Airi is betrayed and falsely accused by her fiance and best friend. At the bottom of despair, another assassin is sent to kill her. However, instead of killing her, the assassin proposes a contract to become her "fake wife."

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

title.native: 冤罪令嬢は信じたい ～銀髪が不吉と言われて婚約破棄された子爵令嬢は暗殺貴族に溺愛されて第二の人生を堪能するようです～
title.romaji: Enzai Reijou wa Shinjitai: Ginpatsu no Fukitsu to Iwarete Konyaku Haki sareta Shishaku Reijou wa Ansatsu Kizoku ni Dekiai sarete Daini no Jinsei wo Tannou suru You desu

198260.description:
Kurosu Kengo, a man who ran away from society after being bullied, spends his days commuting between his home and the arcade. His only purpose in life is fighting games. Kengo is abnormally devoted to fighting games, and one day he realizes that he can now replicate the movements of game characters. However, a former bully interferes with Kengo's life... This is an exciting, life-changing action story about an unemployed man who somehow becomes the strongest fighter!

(Source: YanMaga Web, translated)

title.native: 無職格闘‐ニート・コンバット‐

198262.description:
Rito is a shy girl who dreams of a typical high school romance. Her complex is her large breasts. By chance, she meets an art boy named Shibata, who says to her, "Let me create that body," and her youth is set in motion. The pure "sculpture-making" romantic comedy begins!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: キミのトルソをつくりたい
シスターと触手: 邪眼の聖女と不適切な魔女
title.romaji: Sister to Shokushu: Jagan no Seijo to Futekisetsu na Majo

198264.description:
Natsumi causes trouble at school, which catches the attention of a scummy student guidance counselor. He then punishes Natsumi by hypnotizing her so she'll fulfill his filthy desires.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Released at Comiket 96

title.english: A Gyaru's Hypnosis Training From a Dirty Old Man
title.native: 汚いおっさんがギャルを催眠調教する話
title.romaji: Kitanai Ossan ga Gal wo Saimin Choukyou Suru Hanashi

title.native: 落ちこぼれ転移者、全てを奪うハッキングスキルで最強に成り上がる ～最強ステータスも最強スキルも、触れただけで俺のものです～
title.romaji: Ochikobore Tenisha, Subete wo Ubau Hacking Skill de Saikyou ni Nariagaru: Saikyou Status mo Saikyou Skill mo, Fureta Dake de Ore no Monodesu

198267.description:
What would you do if you discovered someone at your work was having an affair? Perhaps you'd choose to leave the matter alone because it's not really any of your business. However, if left unchecked, that may all change in an instant.

Has an affair at your workplace gotten out of hand? Is it hindering your job and making the work environment suffocating? If so, that may be a job for Rei Saegusa, the cool and sophisticated breakup specialist at Affair Enders. Who will be Rei's target next?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 御社の不倫の件～絶対に別れさせます～
title.romaji: Onsha no Furin no Ken: Zettai ni Wakaresasemasu

198268.description:
Tomoko is 37 years old and works in the general affairs department. In the same department is a woman known for her eccentricity, Haru Hatsuse. She doesn't care at all about how others see her, wearing flashy clothes and saying whatever she feels like without reading the room. Tomoko's friends mock Hatsuse and call her "a quirky and strong willed elderly single woman." One day, Tomoko's friends start to see Tomoko in the same way and make fun of her... Do all women have to worry about having an "aging look"? Or aim for marriage? Hatsuse, who has always lived being true to herself, somehow makes other women's lives burdened with various problems, a little easier to live!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: To Whom It May Concern, I'm Just Fine on My Own
title.native: 各位、私のことはお構いなく
title.romaji: Kakui, Watashi no Koto wa Okamainaku

198269.description:
Eight years ago, Do Seung-Ho, who killed his mother, ran away from his only friend Shin Jae-Hui, who knew his secret. Seung-Ho, who thought he could leave behind the past when he ran away from his hometown and suffered financial hardships and dream of a happy future with his lover Yeong-Jin, who he can envy, when Jae-Hui appears in front of him one day...

"There is no one in this world who will understand you except me, Seung-Ho."

Seung-Ho's life begins to fall into chaos once again when Jae-Hui appears, claiming to have evidence of his mother's death.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

198270.description:
7 years ago, Ki-Tae fell for actor Shin-Woo by chance and became obsessed with him. After stalking him alone for several years, he won the lottery and planned to kidnap Shin-Woo with the money he earned. He hid his real name and got a job as a manager, getting closer step by step, and finally kidnapped Shin-Woo and brought him back...

"Did you think I wouldn't know? Mr. Byun Ki-Tae?"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

198271.description:
"Am I a bad friend to you?"

Ji-Min, who is now in the same class as Ki-Jung, the source of all kinds of rumors and an object of avoidance. Contrary to expectations that it would be a difficult year, ordinary days pass by. Then one day, he spots Ki-Jung approaching a stray cat he was taking care of, and this becomes the opportunity for the two to gradually become closer...

Ji-Min skips school for the first time in his life and goes to a karaoke room. He knows it's an important time, but for some reason, he can't refuse to be with Ki-Jung.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

198272.description:
I was hit by a car while protecting a child, and before I knew it, I had been reincarnated as Yumie Granbell, the daughter of a count in another world. When I looked in the mirror, the reflection staring back at me was an extraordinarily beautiful girl who looked like an angel! Moreover, the Granbell family, into which I was born in this life, is a prestigious magical family with considerable influence. I thought I had hit the jackpot in life, but it turned out that the Granbell family was actually on the verge of collapse… To restore the family, I decided to use my kindness as a weapon!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 転生した俺が可愛いすぎるので、愛されキャラを目指してがんばります
title.romaji: Tensei shita Ore ga Kawaii Sugiru node, Aisare Chara wo Mezashite Ganbarimasu

198273.description:
In order to rescue her admired senior, Anju, who disappeared while logged into the mixed reality FPS online game "Assault Addict," high school girl Ayane Taniura decides to join the game with three friends. However, the other three each have their own hidden agendas, and the missing Anju has a mysterious side to her...

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

title.native: アサルト・アディクトｘＲ

198274.description:
Princess Luche, married into the empire for political reasons, launches a desperate plan to melt Prince Rinon's cold heart—!

A romantic battle of love and intrigue from Yuki Nozawa, creator of Hanazono ni Miki ga Tatsu!

(Source: Harta, translated)

198275.description:
The era is the Tenpo era, set in the Edo period, on the eve of the end of the Tokugawa shogunate.

In a world where common people suffer from high prices, rice shortages, political corruption, and epidemics, a lost swordsman and his Akita dog embark on a journey in pursuit of "righteousness" and "strength."

Where do they come from, and where are they headed?

Will they find light or darkness at the end?

198276.description: Involved in a tragic incident, the protagonist is the sole survivor… until he chooses to end his own life. But upon awakening, he finds himself in another world—unknown and fantastical. There begins the explosive adventure of the most powerful black knight, born into a parallel universe!

198277.description:
A disturbing request arrives at the dollmaker's workshop. The ghost of a boy watches the doll take shape. Trapped in this world, he harbors a question?! A tale of what meets the eye and what remains unseen!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

title.native: ファントム イン・ザ・ドール
かくも素敵なヌミノーゼ

198279.description:
Lee Chan has spent his entire life chasing the shadow of Kwon Taesan, the legendary Olympic Taekwondo star who saved him when no one else would. But just as Chan’s feelings deepen into something deeper, Taesan vanishes into thin air, leaving behind a single text: “Don’t look for me.” Years later, Chan finally tracks his first love down to a sleepy countryside town, only to find his once-savior living as a single father to a baby who is surely his own. Worse yet, Taesan has absolutely no memory of who Chan is. Now, Chan must navigate the secrets of Taesan’s sudden disappearance and figure out how to reclaim a spot in the broken life of the man he never stopped loving.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Night Parade of 100 Demons Organizing Committee

198281.description:
Short manga celebrating Chiho Saitou's first collection of BL one shots and illustrations.

Note: Published in BE×BOY GOLD 2018-04

198282.description:
As the sole princess of the empire, Vishnahel had her life all planned out until she was brutally executed. Thanks to her family’s ancestral god, she’s sent back in time… to live as her 5-year-old self! In order to restore glory to the empire, she must raise hell, team up with her new adopted father (whom she met in prison), and gather the most unlikely allies. With this first-time dad under her thumb, she’s about to prove that sometimes the best way to win is to break all the rules!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Never Let Go of a Black-Haired Dad
The Black-Haired Dad Is Not Reaping
A black-haired father is not abandoned

title.native: 검은 머리 아빠는 거두는 게 아니다
title.romaji: Geomeun Meori Appaneun Geoduneun Ge Anida

198284.description:
Choi Jae-Seung has spent years indulging in one-night stands with BDSM partners, always as a willing masochist. But during a model casting, he suddenly comes face-to-face with the very person who awakened that desire in him: his high school senior, Min Ho-Yeon. After 13 years, Ho-Yeon has returned as Eli, a mysterious top model from the U.S. - and he wastes no time forcing his way back into Jae-Seung’s body and life. What begins as unwanted contact spirals into a dangerous reunion where desire, power, and old wounds collide.

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: The Black Gal Who Became The Homeroom Teacher's Maid

title.native: 担任のメイドになっちゃった黒ギャル
title.romaji: Tannin no Maid ni Nacchatta Kuro Gal

198286.description:
The protagonist is an ordinary college student whose mother has a secret. His senior, who likes to film mature married women having sex, shows him a new movie in which his mother is featured. The protagonist fantasizes about his mother being turned into a dirty old hag... having raw sex and creampied by a man other than his father, and becomes more aroused than ever before. What action will he take?!

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Masyo 2025-10, 12, 2026-02

title.native: 熟女好きな俺の新しい扉
title.romaji: Jukujo Sukina Ore no Atarashii Tobira
Youka-go Tsuma no Haha wo Daku

198288.description:
My new roommate is my fave idol?!
Company employee Haruma has two main hobbies: stanning a popular male idol group and playing an online RPG game. When noise complaints from the neighbors force him to find a new place to live, his gaming buddy offers to let him move in as a roommate. Everything is going smoothly... until the day of the move, when he sees the guy in person and realizes he's just moved in with his fave idol, Ryuta! Haruma decides to hide the fact that he's a fan, but that doesn't save him from the overwhelming power of Ryuta's puppy-dog eyes as he pleads for Haruma to help him with the "skin-to-skin contact" he's been missing. Things are escalating quickly in this secret love affair between a super idol and his loyal fan!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 推しアイドル様のお気に召すまま
title.romaji: Oshi Idol-sama no Oki ni Mesu Mama

title.native: いとしのミスターチェリーボーイ

synonyms: The darkest hour is the dawn special story

title.native: 夜明けがいちばん暗い to repeat
title.romaji: Yoake ga Ichiban Kurai: to repeat

title.native: かわいいしっぽのかくしかた

198297.description:
"You really shouldn't tease guys so much."
The wild rom-com of a story that pairs the earnest lady's man with the unintentional flirt!

Haru, in hopes of starting his college life off with a bang, joins the tennis club which is rumored to be a seedy place where the girls are down for anything. Upon his arrival however, he is met with a room full of guys! Expecting to be the one doing the flirting, Haru instead finds himself being unusually adored by his male classmates. When Haru is leered at by the others at a drinking party, a freshman named Leo—who is very popular with the ladies—steps in to save him. Haru drunkenly confides in Leo, but unintentionally teases him in the process. It's then that Leo asks, "What are you doing in this club if you're not having sex?" Before pushing him down and kissing him! "I just wanna be popular with girls, not guys!"

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 陽くんはオトコたらし
ふるふるあられ、雨のあと

198299.description:
Ma Beom-Tae, whose dream of becoming a hero was given up on false charges, receives a second chance. He must debut on a survival program and become a hero. But being a K-hero these days isn't as easy as it sounds. Working seven days a week, donating money, constantly feeling guilty, and colleagues going crazy...

Will Ma Beom-Tae be able to keep his dream alive?

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: It's Hard to Be a Hero in Korea

Notes:
- Originally self-published under the titles "Shakaijin Kouhai X Senpai Manga (社会人後輩×先輩漫画)" and "Chiri Mau Machi no Futari no (塵舞う街のふたりの)", was then licensed and compiled by Kadokawa for commercial release.
- Includes two extra chapters.

198301.description:
Jun-Seok just started working after his military service. When he visited his uncle's funeral, he met his aunt, Hui-Ae, who he lived with when he was a kid. When he hugged her with his childhood memories in his mind, the scent of each other stimulated their nerves.

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

198302.description:
On October 16, 1793, as the winds of revolution raged in France, one woman died on the guillotine. Her name was Marie Antoinette. She died with pride and dignity...or so she thought, but instead, she was dragged before a suspicious person calling himself "God" in a mysterious dimension that seemed to be the afterlife, and before you knew it, she was reincarnated as a company employee in modern-day Japan! All she could rely on was the survival skills she'd learned at Versailles! The comedy of Marie Antoinette, the former Queen of France, descended into the Reiwa era, begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: オフィス勤めのマリー・アントワネット

198303.description:
1-3. Osananajimi to Koi (幼なじみと恋); drap 2022-04, 06, 08
Hazumi, a university student, is dating his cool and slightly overprotective childhood friend, Touma, who confessed his feelings to him. However, even though it has been two years since they started dating, their relationship has only gone so far as to kiss, which worries Hazumi. It seems that Touma thinks that Hazumi is in love with another childhood friend, Haruchika!

4-6. Otona no Koi wo Mou Ichido (大人の恋をもう一度); drap 2022-10, 12, 2023-02

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Otona no Koi wo Mou Ichido

198304.description:
"Young people these days really lack the feeling of respect for their elders!" Magna, the only alchemist in a village suffering from depopulation and aging, was suffering from power harassment. Feeling a sense of duty to be relied upon by the villagers, Magna endured harsh working conditions, but the reality was one of malicious exploitation...!? An unexpected anti-"old fogey" and life-reversal adventure story in another world begins!

(Source: Magazine Pocket, translated)

title.romaji: Genkai Shuuraku wo Datsu Mura shita Renkinjutsushi, Tokai de "Saikyou" nano ga Baremakuru. Rougai-domo ni wa Iikagen Aiso ga Tsukimashita

198305.description:
“Father, please go to prison in my place."

On the day before his wedding, Ryu Seo-ho, a team leader in insurance assessment, kills someone in a drowsy‑driving accident. The person he turns to in order to cover up the incident is his father — a man he cut ties with 15 years ago. But from that day on, their false conspiracy begins to dredge up the long‑buried truth of the past that had been hidden for those 15 years.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Even if It Rots, It's Still Blood

title.native: 有休オメガ 三三九度
有休オメガ 子守唄
有休オメガ 依依恋恋

198310.description:
After living and dying as a loyal blade for an evil emperor, Kyne Rator is killed by his closest friend, Halo Reston. Reborn as Caron Reston, Halo’s youngest grandson, he refuses to live another life bound by loyalty and devotes himself to becoming strong enough to never wear a leash again. But fate draws him back when he is chosen by the oath stone, and the evil emperor’s lingering power begins to stir once more. As the mad dog of House Reston, can Caron truly walk his own path?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Mad Dog of the Ducal House

title.english: The Mad Dog of the Duke's Estate

198311.description:
Born the despised daughter of a noble family, Lunia escapes her grim fate by marrying the cursed Duke, Hades Khronoa. But after a single loveless night, she vanishes without a trace, unaware that she’s carrying his children. Seven years later, Hades is determined to reclaim Lunia and finds her... as well as the children he never knew existed. As secrets resurface and emotions reignite, can this broken couple untangle the past and face the future together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

198315.description:
Tired of getting mocked and bullied for her weight, Yume has been shutting herself away in her room more and more, not spending time with anyone except her childhood friend, Hisa. But after Hisa lets slip how sexy he finds her, Yume starts exploring with him, reclaiming old insults on her own terms and learning to love her body.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.romaji: Nuugyuu Musume: Osananajimi no Inkya Muchimuchi Musume to Nuugyuu Play ni Fukeru Natsuyasumi

198316.description:
Kashiwagi is a boy who seems physically intimidating but is actually rather frail and prone to fainting. Igarashi is a popular gal at the center of the school social circle. The only connection between these two is their special abilities for "out-of-body projection" and "ability to ignite"!

(Source: Morning Two, translated)
synonyms: When I Woke Up, the Blue Was Burning

198318.description:
When they were first engaged, Janet and Rihanel were in love. However, after Janet’s three years in prison for burning down the chapel that Rihanel grew up in, their engagement is nothing more than a sham they keep up for financial reasons. Eventually, Rihanel says he will marry Janet on one condition: she will allow him to injure her ten times. Rihanel actually has the ability to see a person’s memories by touching their blood, and he wishes to seek out the secrets that run in Janet’s veins, including whether she truly loves him.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Korean.

Natsuki, caught up in a romantic entanglement, decides to leave the band to avoid causing any problems. While playing her bass, pouring her pent-up emotions into the music and even crying, a tough-looking young man approaches her and says, "I really love your bass playing!

A coming-of-age love story between a musical prodigy and a charismatic character.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

198321.description:
What happens when a jaded superstar and a desperate flop idol are forced into the ultimate adult playground? Jesse has conquered the music industry but lost his passion, while Tae-Hui is a five-year veteran of an obscure group starving for a single taste of success. Their paths collide on the set of an outrageous, high-stakes erotic variety show where contestants must strip away their modesty to conquer five scandalous stages. With a single winner-takes-all prize on the line, neither idol can afford to back down from the show's increasingly raunchy challenges. But the more they try to outmaneuver each other under the flashing lights, the harder it becomes to hide their exploding chemistry from the viewfinder.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

198322.description:
Seong-Ho, a former boxer, develops his spiritual sight by chance, and because of the hallucinations he keeps seeing, he ends up quitting boxing. And then he becomes a YouTuber who experiences abandoned houses...

Hello, subscribers! This is Ghost Punch-✩ Today, I came to experience an abandoned house at XX o'clock, and I feel a strange energy here, so I'm going to try to talk to him.

"Hello, are you there? If you have anything to say, just say it and I'll listen."

"...... I love you, I love you Seong-Ho."

The bachelor ghost(?) in the abandoned house follows Seong-Ho around, and his ordinary daily life becomes more and more noisy.

"Get out! You ghost!"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Hwang Min-Ki, who had been keeping a safe distance from people due to his obsessive-compulsive disorder, is suddenly kicked out of his house one day and ends up moving into a company dormitory. However, his roommate is none other than Lee Hyun-Seong, a junior in the same department who is notorious for being dirty...! Min-Ki cannot stand Hyun-Seong's dirty appearance and the room that smells like trash, so he takes him to the bathroom and pours water on him.

"No, senior! I'm so sensitive that I get goosebumps just from the feeling of washing foam!!!"

What should he do with this junior with this absurd constitution?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

The year is 1971, and the once-popular manga artist Yoshihiko Kurumizawa is in a major slump. The pressure builds as each new submission is rejected. But one day, he meets a young, promising artist named Kensaku Hata. When he sees Hata's wonderful work, Kurumizawa hatches a dark plan...

Magical Boy Maple has one goal and one goal only: to protect the land from the evil hordes that seek to conquer and destroy it. Any lewd thoughts are just…a byproduct! He’s dedicated to his cause, that’s for sure, but his powers have yet to fully develop. That is, until the dark leader Daisy comes into his life. One look at those thick thighs and bulging pecs and - poof! - Maples magic comes in. And when the magical gods gift you tentacles, what else are you supposed to do if not use them…?!

Otose-kun, a male college student, loves being "cute" while crossdressing! But one day, his classmate Tachibana (♂) finds out about his hobby. What does Tachibana want in exchange for keeping the secret? They connect with each other through "cuteness" ♪

“You’re just what our club needs!!”

Tsubaki Kouichirou is a freshman drowning in fame: girls want to date him, guys want to be him. Just a few months back, in middle school, it was the complete opposite, until an encounter with a mysterious girl changed everything. Falling in love at first sight, he undergoes a makeover and enrolls in the same school as her, determined to make this love blossom… But now where is she?!?

(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Say Hello To My Embarrassing Past

198337.description:
In a medieval East Asian-style world, Tsering is an orphan raised by a blind pharmacist, Setsua, and lives peacefully deep in the mountains. One day, while out gathering medicinal herbs, Tsering is attacked by a "Tsuai", a demon that harms people...

A passionate Asian fantasy depicting life and death, humans and demons, and the cycle of life.

198338.description:
In a run-down shopping street, brothers Fuji and Kiri run a small barbershop as they wait for their father’s return. In their effort to make ends meet, every day brings something new to their door.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 彼女に下着を届けたら

198340.description:
Androids and bonsai trees have one thing in common: they'll both outlast a human's lifespan. Kanna, an android, received lessons from the "Sensei" who ran the bonsai shop, Kifu Garden. As "Sensei" regaled her with the wonders of bonsai, Kanna would watch with eyes full of curiosity...

A long time has passed since then, and Kanna is the only one remaining at Kifu Garden, when someone new comes to visit... A completely new human drama woven by the long lives of an android and bonsai trees.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Benkei, a super weapon collector and enthusiast, was deeply troubled. Beautiful weapons, powerful weapons... 198349.description:
Louise Ideana, a survivor of the fallen Ideana family, has been living in hiding as a maid. Then one day, Shayde Lupus, the slave she once sold, appears before her as a duke. Though Louise denies knowing him, Shayde has not forgotten her. With cold fury and lingering obsession, he makes it clear that he has no intention of letting her escape him again. As the woman who lost everything and the man who rose from nothing cross paths once more, their reunion is shadowed by power, resentment, and a past neither of them can escape.

(Source: WEBTOON)

198350.description:
Moments before her execution at the Emperor's hands, Manae Frey makes a plea for their illegitimate daughter to be protected at all costs. But after a desperate pact with a mysterious monster, Manae awakens to find she now inhabits her young daughter’s body. Given a second chance as Lilina, Manae resolves to seize the life her daughter was denied — and prove to the Calvaria Empire that she’s more than just a forgotten child. She will claim her place as a true princess, no matter what it takes!

(Source: Tapas)

198352.description:
Haruzora is a popular female professional wrestler, and Eiko is a ruthless heel. The two clash fiercely in matches, but they share a secret: they are lovers and live together. This yuri comedy depicts the contrast between their passionate relationship in the ring and their sweet relationship at home.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

198353.description:
"Destranaide! Mai Mero-chan" is the story of two sisters, the cute little sister Mero and her older sister Nii. Nii dotes on her sister, and when Mero says she wants bread for breakfast, she immediately throws away the rice balls she had prepared for her, and when Mero says she wants to shoot beams from her eyes, she develops beam-shooting eyes. Nii wants to grant her sister's wishes, but she refuses to agree to Mero's request to go outside. Mero is not just a cute little sister, she has dangerous powers hidden within. This is a destructive everyday comedy in which the love of sisters draws the world into it.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

198356.description:
If only she could remember his face!

A one-night stand. Three possible suspects— er, lovers. Who did Bori really sleep with that night? A steamy office romance unfolds as our heroine follows the clues to find her man.

(Source: Manta)

198358.description:
Due to her stunning beauty and superb acting skills, actress Shin Sojin has been loved by everyone... except for Mrs. Jung, a cruel tycoon who has tormented Sojin all her life. But when wealthy CEO, Kang Seung-Won, offers her a sponsorship, Sojin seizes the chance to take her down. With Seung-Won by her side, Sojin slowly works toward getting her vengeance. But the closer she gets to her goal, the more she begins to realize that there is something deeper and darker about this arrangement...

(Source: Tapas)

198359.description:
Is it intentional or innocent?! A messy-minded rom-com that lives up to its name!! Matsura is a calm, composed high school boy who’s always lived his life putting up a front. He’s good at reading people and can easily see through their true nature, but for unknown reasons, he’s constantly approached by Kyuragi—a beautiful girl with pigtails who’s part of the popular group! Whether it’s intentional or not, her playful and cunning actions keep throwing him off, and before he knows it, Matsura is yelling, "Stop! I'm falling for you!"

(Source: Manga Plus)

It's been 68 years since the Culling Game. In 2086, an alien race known as the Simurians arrive on Earth in a spaceship. The fate of the world lies in the hands of two jujutsu sorcerers Yuka and Tsurugi Okkotsu. Jujutsu sorcerers and aliens, what chaos will be born from this meeting?

Eunwon, who has a one-sided crush on their older brother, Woosuk, has been living with him for a year. Actually, Woosuk is not their biological brother, but their older step-brother...however, to be close to him, Eunwon even cross-dressed and became his roommate. They anticipated a heart-fluttering campus life, but everything changed after a night with a drunk Woosuk at a club gathering. Woosuk acts like nothing happened, having no memory of the event, leaving Eunwon confused. Finally, Eunwon decides to sleep with the drunk Woosuk again...

Her fiancé, the crown prince, loved her sister, who was as lovely and pretty as a fairy.

Uzuno is a clumsy girl who always gets people's names wrong, picks up trash with a bag full of holes, and is careless about her appearance. Tsunoda came to the city to avoid the overly intrusive lifestyle in the countryside, and he struggles with being a busybody. However, his relationship with Uzuno is strangely comfortable, and he likes her nickname "Sumire," which was born from a mispronunciation of his name. He decides to spend his days exploring a new side of himself, relaxing.

Liebe was reincarnated into such a world as a demon. He died in an accident just as he was becoming desperate due to bullying. However, he was reincarnated into a world where demons were treated poorly. Liebe was also made a slave (pet) to the daughter of a frontier noble, and spent his days serving her. Even though he wanted to fight back, his slave contract prevented him from doing anything. However, Liebe possessed special eyes that allowed him to see his opponents' weaknesses. Combining this power with magic, he developed a spell that temporarily repelled the slave contract. Since he'd gone to all the trouble of becoming a demon, he decided to become the hope of the demons... and become the strongest demon king! This is the start of a rebellious fantasy about the rise of the weakest demon race!

Because in this world, instead of gaining power through intimate encounters, anyone who loses their virginity becomes cursed. Yes, cursed. In a supposed mature fantasy. How does that even make sense? While I am still trying to wrap my head around this ridiculous twist, I receive my main mission: help the story’s second male lead achieve his destined romance. Avoid curses, dodge questionable situations, fix the love plot, survive the chaos, all with my purity intact.

Can I possibly complete this mission without destroying the entire story, or myself, first?

198462.description:
After being cheated on by his partner and breaking off the relationship, Sakura searches for men night after night in order to satiate his thirst for body warmth. One day, an unknown man gets in the way of his chance of having sex and to his surprise, that unknown man is Hasegawa, an employee in the same company he works at. Sakura forbids him to talk about the other night, and Hasegawa proposes that if he feels lonely they should then live together.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

198464.description:
Haruka is now in his second year of high school and Shu is in his third and final year of junior high school. Haruka, considering his future profession, decides to study abroad. But he cannot tell this to Shu because Shu is busy preparing for his last baseball tournament in junior high school. The two boys think deeply of each other. And in their fourth spring, when the cherry blossoms are in full bloom, their heights are no longer different...

(Source: Takeshobo)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

title.english: Notes of Springtide ~With You, in Full Bloom~
title.romaji: Senshun Kansoku: Sakura Mau Kimi to

As she gradually regains her "self," and even receives the blessings of the gods, Rozemyne's rampage becomes even more unstoppable! "Spread my book-loving virus to everyone!"

The two had a somewhat cold relationship, but for some reason Laurence is unable to except the idea of breaking of the engagement...? A Love story that begins with the beginning of the end.

Since then, he’s spent nights with various partners, but no matter what he does, he’s never been able to experience the same pleasure he felt that day and before he knows it, six years have passed. One day, the man responsible for that unforgettable experience, Kuroda, transfers to Miyakawa’s company. Miyakawa’s heart races at the reunion with his old college friend, but it seems Kuroda isn’t simply happy to see him as a friend…

A university student named Osaka Nao reincarnates as the villainous young master Lian in a game. He is tasked with raising the future hero Alfred into a capable man and making him fulfill his mission to save the world.

Despite Lian’s efforts to be disliked, it has no effect… In fact, Alfred seems to like him…!? While Lian grows increasingly anxious, Alfred keeps getting closer and closer…!? “Hey, is it okay if I touch you more?”

In a world divided into three realms, the floating islands of Paradise, the surface of Eden, and the subterranean depths of Proserpina, Meove clings to a single hope: escaping to the sky with Haluk. Their love is the only light in the dark, but it is quickly extinguished when a sudden revolution tears through the underground. In the blink of an eye, the life they knew is gone, leaving Meove to navigate a treacherous new destiny where Paradise feels further away than ever.

198549.description:
Diana, the second daughter of a frontier earl, lives a free life surrounded by her muscle-brained brothers in a remote region. One day, she is suddenly forced to marry by royal decree! Her partner is the Duke's son, Lacilus, who is known for his intelligence and good looks. In fact, this marriage was arranged to avoid any unnecessary conflicts after the princess of the country to which Lacilus was meant to marry was forced to marry off in order to secure peace with a neighboring country.

"The Duke's son feels sorry for the beautiful princess being succeeded by the muscle-brained daughter of a frontier earl... Isn't this what he meant when he said, 'I have no intention of loving you!'?" This is the story of the misunderstandings between Diana, the self-proclaimed "wild monkey" new wife who has given up all expectations and reservations, and her husband, Lacilus, whose mask as a good-looking young man is soon to be torn away.

(Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

198555.description:
I'm Kagamihara Machi, an immortal vampire. I was born in the West and am about 600 years old. I came to Japan during the Sengoku period and have lived here ever since. But human life is very short, and even though I've made some wonderful friends, they all die before me. I get so lonely being alone over and over again... And I'm bored! I'm so bored I feel like I'm going to die! But I've finally found a way to avoid loneliness! The answer lies in my university's intercollegiate club!!

(Source: Mangalt, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

198556.description:
Su Xiao, a girl from the modern century, accidentally transmigrates to ancient times and inhabits the body of the Second Lady of the Prime Minister's manor. Pushed around and often brought to her knees, the Second Lady falls in love with a complete jerk before dying in the hands of a malicious villain. However, from now on, she will no longer be a foolish, meek little girl! She will make all of her enemies pay... Very, very dearly!

(Source: WebComics)

198557.description:
In August 1937, after years of tension between China and Japan, clashes broke out between the two countries in Shanghai. For more than three months, this international city became a zone of conflict, with hundreds of thousands of soldiers engaged in fierce fighting.

(Source: Urban China, translated)

198558.description:
In 1279, China came under Mongol rule for the first time. The Yuan dynasty, founded by Kublai Khan—the grandson of Genghis Khan—had effectively assimilated almost the entire Middle Kingdom. But in Yashan, an island off the southern coast, a last bastion of the former Song dynasty still resisted. One of the greatest naval battles in history was about to take place...

(Source: Urban China, translated)

198559.description:
After discovering her boyfriend of three years was cheating, being forced into a blind date with a divorced man ten years her senior, and carrying the financial burden of her suffocatingly dependent family, Yoon Seol-Young finds herself trapped in a harsh reality.

Just when she wishes for a way out, Ki Tae-Hwan—an executive director of the Shinhwa Group, rumored to be gay due to his excessively private lifestyle—approaches her.

"Marry me. I’ll take you to a higher place."

In the blink of an eye, Seol-yYung goes from executive secretary to the daughter-in-law of the Shinhwa Group! But what is Tae-Hwan’s true purpose behind this sudden proposal of marriage…?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

198562.description:
I possessed a character in a female-oriented dating simulation game. As the Second Prince, he seduces the female protagonist to overcome his inferiority complex toward the First Prince, Edward. I don't want to be killed by Edward. I don't want to interfere with someone else's love life, and I don't want to be hated.

"You like her. I have no feelings for her."

"Right. It's better not to like her. You'll never end up with her."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
