198563.description:
The Buddha of Fighting descends to the human world!

An incident occurs in which demons escape from hell and hide in the human world. Son Oh-Gong, on the orders of the Jade Emperor, descends to the human world to capture the escaped demons. Concerned that the demons, startled by his extraordinary magical powers, will escape, he decides to hide in the body of an ordinary high school boy, Ryu Ha-Seon.

"From now on, I am the Buddha who will return victorious from battle, the Fighting Buddha, the Fighting Buddha, the Fighting Buddha, descends to the human world!"

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: The Return of the Crazy Monkey King

198564.description:
In the jail known as Solitude of Karaisman, trillions of prisoners are kept in brutal conditions. Somehow, a blind man named Argel Lastos has survived for decades, despite being one of the prison’s first inmates. Now, he’s determined to protect and train a child named Cero to turn his unrealized talent into a fearsome power, all while defending his friends from the desperate inmates. But, is the old man only doing it to save Cero… or is it for a far more sinister purpose?

(Source: Tapas)

Sosildo, an uninhabited island cursed by a god, is now uninhabited. A four-member occult club visits Sosildo for summer vacation, only to be attacked and killed by a mysterious monster. When they open their eyes, it's back to their first day on the island. The curse forces them to repeat the same day over and over again. To escape, they must find five objects on a map... Will they be able to escape safely?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

198566.description:
A peaceful guesthouse! A place where everyone can rest safely! No class distinctions! No history! Here, only love and peace reign! No factions, no sects, no good or bad, no great heroes, no demons, no witches, no nemesis! And so...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

198567.description:
Marianne doesn't consider her mother's husbands as family. Their marriages end too quickly for her to get attached. But this time, her mother's latest match brings her a stepbrother, Orion. And he's eager to dote on his new sister, even though their parents' marriage might not last. That's why Marianne is determined to ignore him, but Orion's shenanigans soon prove too outrageous to dismiss. Can Marianne convince Orion she wants to be left alone? Or will she warm up to her weird new brother?

(Source: Tapas)

When a perpetually overlooked supporting actor dies wishing to be jaw-droppingly handsome, he's reborn as Ma Gongja, a ridiculously beautiful baby who was left outside an orphanage. After a famous actress adopts him, Gongja suddenly has fame, fortune, and everyone falling for his cuteness, but he's just getting started! Armed with acting skills, this charming child is determined to become the most dazzling star there is, but will his stunning looks cause more trouble than he bargained for?

198570.description:
After suffering from various obsessive-compulsive disorders and having the worst day of her life, Won Do-Yeon's house is infested with cockroaches. Unable to bear the urge due to her obsessive-compulsive disorder, Do-Yeon asks deliveryman Bok Geum-Ho to exterminate them. However, Geum-Ho, rebuffed by his out-of-the-blue advances, throws the roaches into Do-Yeon's home instead. Do-Yeon eventually hires a cockroach exterminator from a secondhand goods trading platform. Geum-Ho, who has fallen in love with Do-Yeon, becomes jealous of her. Panicked by the roaches, Do-Yeon seeks help from her father, Won Hyuk-Su, who lives in the countryside. He heads to Seoul to reunite with his daughter, with whom he has lost contact. Won Hyuk-Su, the exterminator, and Bok Geum-Ho gather to exterminate the roaches, but someone dies on the spot. This incident triggers a series of cockroach-related incidents, rewriting Won Do-Yeon's family history, torn apart by her obsessive-compulsive disorder.

198600.description:
Up-and-coming actor Arashi Hinami is wildly jealous of the more popular actor Tooru Ootaki. After watching Tooru's most recent movie, Arashi goes to his usual members-only gentleman's club to clear his head.
At this club everyone hides their face, and don't pry into private matters. Here Arashi is instantly drawn to a mysterious and alluring man, and they spend a passionate night together.
The next morning Arashi sees that the man he had a perfect physical connection with is none other than... Tooru Ootaki? Not only that, they're about to star in a drama together!

title.native: フェイクフィクション

title.native: 侵略！ 宇宙猫チャン！

198604.description:
Right after graduating high school, Yewon falls headfirst into an affair with the charming but married Han Ju-eon. She knows it’s wrong, but she doesn’t care. She’s in love.

“I want to hear you say it. Are you having an affair with that guy?”

“Fine! We're having an affair. So what?”

Things start to spiral when their classmate Jeong Hwa-ik catches them in the act and makes her an offer of his own. Whether out of spite, curiosity, or something darker, she agrees.

"Even if I sleep with someone else, you’re not going to leave your wife, are you?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

198605.description:
Fresh out of the military and eager for a fresh start, Ji-Woo returns to university, ready to slip back into the rhythm of normal campus life. His plans hit a sudden, unavoidable roadblock when he is forced to enroll in a course taught by Professor Ha-Yeong. Ji-Woo absolutely dreads the prospect; he carries a deep-seated resentment toward her, stemming from a painful past where he was subjected to her blatant, unfair treatment. Forced to grit his teeth and endure her lectures, he prepares for a grueling semester of academic power games. However, the dynamic changes entirely when Ji-Woo makes a startling discovery: he accidentally stumbles upon a secret, private account managed by Ha-Yeong. Behind the facade of the strict, demanding educator lies a completely different personality, and as Ji-Woo peers into her hidden world, he finds his perception of his antagonist crumbling and his intrigue growing.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 編集S木氏 異世界を征く

198607.description:
In this ordinary other world, a party of heroes with no screws has appeared somewhere! Self-proclaimed heroes include the little tank Farming, the gloomy beast wizard Happy, the pervert nun Claire who is not only different from her on the outside, and the cowardly thief Kim Do-Jeok... Unlike other adventurers, these people get caught up in various incidents. One day, they accidentally obtain a magical sword and end up entangled with the Demon King's army...

Will these quirky and lively adventurers be able to overcome all the threats that come their way, shed their self-proclaimed names, and be reborn as a true party of heroes?

(Source: Naver, translated)

198610.description:
Hwarin, a woman in her thirties raising two children in a very poor family, struggles to make ends meet. One day, she swaps bodies with her friend, who is happily married to a wealthy senior colleague—her first love. However, the joy of finally living the life she had long desired is short-lived, as the family’s dark secrets are revealed, and Hwarin finds herself caught in an inescapable trap.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: La casa en la que vives

198612.description:
Aoi, a demon boy hiding his true identity, lives a quiet life as a normal high school student. But one day, a girl suddenly falls from the sky, and she's not what she seems. Get ready for a modern-day pop demon battle from a highly skilled artist in the manga world!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 鬼鬼戒解-キキカイカイ-

198613.description:
Ichika, who has a crush on Asuka, decides to try a love charm. However, what appears before her is a self-proclaimed No.1 Cupid named Yashamaru Manjigahara, who dons a gang-style uniform! With this delinquent-like Cupid in charge, will her love actually work out...!?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 爆走天使 卍ヶ原夜叉丸

198614.description:
Manga artist Shizuka suddenly hits a creative wall. Nothing's going right, and she's completely lost touch with her own feelings... A touching one-shot about reconnecting with yourself.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: By Your Side: Where Happiness Lives
title.native: あなたのそばに ～しあわせの在り処～
title.romaji: Anata no Soba ni: Shiawase no Arika

198615.description:
In the Kingdom of Belbronn, the Weilkast family's mastery of water magic has long been the cornerstone of prosperity, earning the realm the title of “The Land of Beautiful Waters.” However, Lara, the heiress to the Weilkast legacy, is unable to wield water magic, facing neglect and scorn from her family. Amidst this turmoil, a proposal emerges from the Kingdom of Turmhut, grappling with the dire consequences of water pollution. It's a strategic alliance where Turmhut offers substantial wealth in exchange for a union to salvage their realm from contamination-induced catastrophe. The intended suitor? A former crown prince, notorious for prolonged bachelorhood. Instead of Lara's proficient stepsister Mary, the Weilkast family schemes to push Lara into the engagement. Will Lara be able to fulfill her role as the Water Goddess and save a nation drowning in turmoil, even though she cannot wield the element that defines her destiny?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)
synonyms: La Déesse de l'eau : sauver un Royaume sans pouvoir

title.english: Useless Cinderella's Feeble Attempt to Save the Kingdom
title.native: 灰かぶり令嬢と行き遅れ元王太子の結婚
title.romaji: Haikaburi Reijou to Iki Okure Moto Outaishi no Kekkon

198616.description:
Noa Yoyogi has always dreamed of being someone special. One day, she meets a fairy named Mimi, but Mimi is actually a demon, and soon Noa encounters a man who claims to be an exorcist...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.romaji: Mimi to Yoru no Rondo wo

title.native: 超キモチイイ♥ヒミツ特訓

198618.description: One day, Beatrix, a natural-looking marquise, suddenly announces to her maid of honor that she is going to be a villainess. What? Beatrix confesses that she will become a villainess in order to break off her engagement. What is the young lady thinking when she is betrothed to a prince whom everyone admires?

title.native: 悪役令嬢がポンコツすぎて、王子と婚約破棄に至りません
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou ga Ponkotsu Sugite, Ouji to Konyaku Haki ni Itarimasen

title.native: ようこそ!娘々桃花クリニック淫行科♥
title.romaji: Youkoso! Nyan Nyan Touka Clinic Inkouka♥

198620.description:
Renaldo, the lord of a small country estate, was becoming increasingly desperate. He couldn't find a suitable wife. At age 19, he was tall and handsome, but he wasn't particularly wealthy, was extremely shy, and seemed rather unfriendly—so no one seemed interested in marrying him. Furthermore, Renaldo had a secret: he transformed into a werewolf on moonlit nights. Hoping for one last chance, he attended a royal ball in the capital, where he finally met a noble lady named Meredith...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 薬草令嬢ともふもふの旦那様 もふもふシリーズ
title.romaji: Yakusou Reijou to Mofumofu no Danna-sama Mofumofu Series

title.native: 魔法令嬢ともふもふの美少年 もふもふシリーズ
title.romaji: Mahou Reijou to Mofumofu no Bishounen Mofumofu Series

198622.description:
Io used to be the top earner at the host club he worked at and Anii used to be in the yakuza. Now they’re both turning over a new leaf working as tomato farmers! As these two city boys get used to country life, Io decides to use his considerable charm to make Anii fall for him. But Anii turns out to be a challenge: one moment he’s nice and protective of Io, the next second he’s acting cold and trying to push Io away. Can Io and Anii put their shady pasts behind them and build a future together?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Notes:
- Originally published as a one-shot in Dear+ 2024 July issue, was then picked up for serialization.
- Includes one extra chapter.

198625.description:
When Archduke Cesare returns from war, Eileen barely recognizes the man she once knew—he's cold, commanding, and burning with unspoken desire. But nothing shakes her more than his sudden proposal. As old feelings stir, Eileen must choose: take his hand, or flee before his fire consumes her.

(Source: Manta)

198626.description:
The Spartan model training project for confident and unique beauty begins!

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

198627.description:
Suzuka was transported to another world at a young age and imprisoned as a snow shrine maiden, but due to her weak powers she was severely oppressed by Adolf, the king of the snow kingdom, and the people around her. One day, she reunites with her first love, Warren, who helped her when she arrived in the other world, for the first time in 10 years, and her joy is short-lived as he suddenly kisses her...! Suzuka is tossed about by her first love, who has changed since childhood, but she is drawn to him. However, the wheels of fate become more entangled as another shrine maiden, Kako, and Adolf are drawn in - a forbidden other-worldly love fantasy by "The Dropout Shrine Maiden" and "The King of the Enemy Country"!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Why Is His Lying Majesty So Obsessed with Me?

title.native: 嘘つき陛下が私に執着する理由
title.romaji: Usotsuki Heika ga Watashi ni Shuuchaku Suru Riyuu

198628.description:
The girl who drives me crazy... Finding true love for bad girls.

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

198629.description:
Chaedam never planned to get cozy with the sexy CEO, but after discovering Yoowon’s secrets, Chaedam has no choice but to fake amnesia to keep himself safe. Suspicious, Yoowon ups the ante and tells Chaedam that they were lovers before his memory loss. Chaedam knows it’s only a ploy to keep him under Yoowon’s watchful eye, but he can’t reveal the truth without exposing himself to danger. So begins a cat-and-mouse game of deception and lust that sends them tumbling into bed together.

(Source: Tapas)

198630.description:
After casting a spell to posthumously fix his mana growth in a previous life, Seonal Hae now works at the Special Department of Different Species’ Civil Affairs. He now uses his powerful new magical abilities to help anyone who has been maligned because of who they are… even if they’re a medusa, centaur, or vampire!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became a Civil Servant in a Magical World
異種族相談窓口 解決特別課

title.english: I Became the Magic Civil Servant in Isekai

198631.description:
Ji-Yu, who has only ever been 1st in the whole school, receives an unimaginable grade of 2nd place after entering high school. Shocked, Ji-Yu hears that dating will cause grades to drop, so he confesses to Do-Hyeon, the top student in the whole school, in order to regain his position as 1st. But what…? Why are you accepting my confession…?

Will Ji-Yu be able to successfully persuade Do-Hyeon and regain his position as 1st in the whole school!?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

198632.description:
Marie, who has had memories of her past life since she was five years old, finally realizes after enrolling in school that the world she is currently living in is that of her younger sister's favorite otome game! However, she doesn't remember much about the characters or the story of the otome game. Deciding that she doesn't understand anything, she decides to just go for it and aim for a wonderful romance, but she finds herself being liked by the characters she wants to capture, and they're likely to compete with the protagonist for them!

(Source: Comic Pixiv, translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢はシナリオを知らない ～乙女ゲームの世界で真実の恋を探します！～
title.romaji: Akuyaku Rejiou wa Scenario wo Shiranai: Otome Game no Sekai de Shinjitsu no Koi wo Sagashimasu

198633.description:
This is a peaceful forest where herbivores live. Blessed with a husband and children, Momoyo, a flying squirrel, lives a seemingly happy life, but deep inside she feels an indescribable sense of suffocation. With a certain encounter as a catalyst, her destiny slowly begins to change...

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

198640.description:
On her 40th birthday, Yumeko's grandmother died. She was left all alone. She had no family, no boyfriend, and was working as a temporary worker. That's how Yumeko celebrated her birthday. Just as she was wondering what to do next, her in-game lover, Sierra, asked her to move in with her. Though hesitant, Yumeko agreed, and when she headed to Sierra's house, she found the hugely popular actress Shiori Hoshikawa there!

Surprised by this sudden turn of events, Shiori tearfully confessed to Yumeko, "I want to be with you."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

198641.description:
Kumausa is a small bento shop in Usanohanacho. Who is today's customer, drawn in by the smell of delicious food?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Chapters 9 to 13 were split into two parts in the original serialization.

title.native: 幸福のおいしい道すがら

198642.description:
Choco has had a crush on his best friend and gaming buddy Bom for years. Bom has never been able to tell her best friend that she is a trans woman. After they confess their feelings to each other, their days begin to take on new color.

A boy-meets-trans girl story between a geeky boy who's new to romance and a trans woman!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.romaji: Ore no Kanojo wa Kawaii Darouga

title.romaji: Yankee, Oshi to Unmei to Deau

198646.description:
Kageko is a high school girl who has a complex about being "ordinary" in every way. However, during the second semester, she ends up sitting next to Mahiru, a popular student at school and a member of a hugely popular idol group. She thought she lived in a different world from him, a "special" boy who is the complete opposite of her... But by chance, they end up serving as library committee members together! What's more, it seems he has a side to him that those around him don't know about...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ないものねだりの君に光の花束を
title.romaji: Naimononedari no Kimi ni Hikari no Hanataba wo

198647.description:
On Christmas night, after being dumped by her boyfriend, Hiyora suppresses her emotions by cutting her arm. As her arm and heart ached from the cold, a girl jumps in, aiming for her arm. In an instant, she licks Hiyora's arm and says, "Delicious." To her surprise, the girl is a vampire! The vampire praises the confused Hiyora and her arm, which is dripping with blood.

A vampire romance that begins with an encounter at rock bottom begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: コトヤマ短編集　ファンフィクション

198649.description:
I’ll never let you go again...

When Ionia, proud knight of the realm, loses his life in a violent insurrection, his memories are inherited by a boy born one day after his death. Years later, Leorino Cassieux, fourth son of the Margrave of Brungwurt and blessed with angelic beauty, begins to see Ionia’s memories in his dreams. He relives Ionia’s ill-fated romance with the king’s younger brother, Prince Gravis, as well as his death at the hands of a traitor to the kingdom! But as Leorino tries to make sense of the feeling swelling in his chest, he stumbles too close to the truth of that fateful day. The traitor’s identity is revealed, and in a panic, the traitor threatens to end himself and take Leorino with him! As Leorino’s life hangs in the balance, he instinctively cries out for his only hope: the love of his past life, Gravis.

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes one prologue chapter.

198650.description:
It’s the wedding day of beloved youngest son Leorino and the king’s younger brother, Gravis. Despite the lovely ceremony, the Cassieux men seem to be beside themselves with grief. Destined Souls depicts the pasts and futures of twelve men, including Lieutenant General Lucas—who has always loved Ionia—and Crown Prince Kyle with his burden of blood. Meanwhile, Gravis’s valet, Theodor, closed off his heart after taking away the one person his dear master loved, yet Marzel, unable to bear the weight of sin, begins toying with him.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: You Can Have My Back: Destined Souls (Extra Edition)
title.native: 背中を預けるには 　番外編集 運命の男達
title.romaji: Senaka wo Azukeru ni wa: Bangai-henshuu - Unmei no Otokotachi

title.romaji: Senaka wo Azukeru ni wa: Enkon no Ionia

おとなりさんの指先のせい。
ハイド・アンド・シーク
解散させてもらいます！
きみと見た ほうき星を探して～僕のポーラスター～
title.romaji: Kimi to Mita Houkiboshi wo Sagashite: Boku no Polaris

198661.description:
After years of hiding his brilliance as a loyal executive aide, Taesik Yun finally has the chance to face the superiors who once stole his work and destroyed his reputation. He secures his seat as the new Division Director through a high-stakes, 10-billion-won contract marriage to his boss, Munjeong Kang -- the fierce legitimate heir fighting to keep her empire from her illegitimate brother. But as he steps into the spotlight to claim his revenge -- can Taesik survive the cutthroat succession war while navigating a fake marriage that feels increasingly real?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: I'd Rather Live as a Villain

198662.description:
Ma Seok-ho, the strongest high school student known as the nation’s No. 1 “Demon King,” and Jo Jin-ho, an ordinary high school student — the uneasy cohabitation of two souls.

(Source: Naver, translated)

198664.description: Manga adaptation of Victor-Marie Hugo's 1861 novel "Les Misérables".

198665.description:
Yusei has lost both parents, while Hanami struggles with her relationship with her mother. Both grew up at the foot of Mount Fuji, and now they're faced with important decisions about their futures. Questions about themselves. About their families. About themselves and their families. After much worry and suffering, what "destination" will they ultimately choose? A gentle, tender human drama.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: マリンブルーの淡水魚
ウチらワルい子なんで

198667.description:
A strange summer without cicadas singing... It suddenly occurred.

Yuichi and Airi are high school students worried about their future careers. Yuichi lost both of her parents in an accident, while Airi has a strained relationship with hers. They are close friends. However, that summer, a strange phenomenon occurs in their town, with sex workers disappearing one after another. Rumors soon spread that the cause is an infectious disease in which eye-like rashes pop up from the bodies of the women, eating away at them with "something." Airi, who harbors a secret she cannot tell anyone, is frightened by the unknown rumors, but this is only the beginning of a further threat. A sisterhood x panic horror story about girls living under extreme conditions.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synonyms: 『遊び』でもまあいいじゃん＋おまけ

title.native: 彼方へ届いて恋は咲く
title.romaji: Kanata e Todoite Koi wo Saku

198670.description:
Included Stories:
1. Hitozuma Miko to Inshuu (人妻巫女と淫習)
2. Hitozuma Rental (人妻レンタル)
3. Big Cock Campaign Kaisai!! (Big Cockキャンペーン開催！！)
4. Hitozuma-tachi No Ayamachi (人妻たちのアヤマチ)
5. Porori Shika Nai Yodoki! Shirouto Taikou Sanbanshoubu (ポロリしかないよ ドキッ！素人対抗三番勝負)
6. Manatsu No Shinrei Special Seikou Reibaishi Saionji Kaori (真夏の心霊スペシャル・性交霊媒師 西園寺香織)
7. Otto No Misu Wa Tsuma No Misu (夫のミスは妻のミス)
8. Miryoku Consultant (魅力コンサルタント)

title.native: とある村のヒミツの淫習
title.romaji: Toaru Mura no Himitsu no Inshuu

198671.description:
"Looks like this naughty Switch needs to be disciplined."

Suo, a model popular as “the strongest Dom" has a secret - he is actually a Switch with a strong sign of a Sub. One day, a high-caste Dom model named Tokiwa who just transferred to his agency calls him a "low-caste Dom" and Suo hits the roof!! And more, he gets Tokiwa's glare during the photoshoot and feels arousal like a Sub...! Though he doesn't want to obey Tokiwa's commands, Suo's needy body falls for the ecstasy he feels for the first time...

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Look into My Eyes and Kneel
title.romaji: Ore no We wo Mite Hizamazuke

198672.description:
Edith is an orphaned girl who is treated coldly by her stepparents and stepsister. One day, her stepsister receives a marriage proposal from Lionel, the eldest son of the highly prestigious Count of Granvelle. However, there is actually a hidden story behind this proposal... and Edith is suddenly engaged in place of her stepsister. "I'm sorry, you can't be engaged to someone like me. Can you just bear with me for a year?" Her fiancé only has a year left to live, and this is a happy love story in which pure love creates a miracle!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: In Sickness and in Health: How I Got Engaged to the Son of a Marquis with One Year Left to Live

title.native: 義姉の代わりに、余命一年と言われる侯爵子息様と婚約することになりました
title.romaji: Ane no Kawari ni, Yomei Ichi-nen to Iwareru Koushaku Shisoku-sama to Konyaku suru Koto ni Narimashita

198673.description:
Aika (26) is suddenly abandoned by her boyfriend with whom she was living together. She's left alone in a large house, but she doesn't have enough money for rent or moving expenses. What should she do with her life from now on? Aika is at a loss, but... For some reason, she ends up living with Futaba (25), a colleague in the planning department who she barely had any contact with!

This thrilling yuri love comedy about working adults begins with their sudden cohabitation!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: オフィスのつづきはリビングで
title.romaji: Office no Tsuzuki wa Living Room de

198674.description:
Second-year high school student Kuraki quietly draws manga in his free time, but although he wants to draw a bright and bubbly main character, his own more subdued personality means that his main characters always turn out gloomy like him. Then he meets Urara Haruno, a dazzling girl who sparkles like spring sunshine and attends a private school for young ladies from wealthy families. Kuraki is so inspired that he draws a new manga chapter all in one sitting, using Haruno as the model for the main character, but how will she react when she reads the manga herself?! This is a school love story of an artist, his muse, and their budding relationship!

(Source: K MANGA)

198675.description:
The next mission for skilled police officers Kanemitsu Makoko and Otomo Sir is to become manga artists in order to defeat evil! Friendship! Passion! Action! The two super cops take on the unpredictable path of manga!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: にこけい！　怒りのマンガ刑事

198676.description:
Miyuki and Hikari are childhood friends and longtime gals who are now in their third year of high school. They spend their days doing silly things and having fun, but Hikari has a special ability: she can see other people's lifespans and give them her lifespan. Miyuki wants Hikari not to use her ability, but Hikari's lifespan is getting shorter and shorter...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 寿命をゆずる友だちの話。
title.romaji: Jumyou wo Yuzuru Tomodachi no Hanashi.

198677.description:
From Tsutsui Itsuki, creator of "Laughing in a Night Storm" and "Kisaragi Ibun," comes a coming-of-age story about a girl disappointed in herself and a Yankee girl with a purple flame.

Oka Nozomi is a high school student attending a local art prep school with the goal of entering an art college. Despite her diligent painting skills, she is passively accepting her lack of improvement and maintains her peace of mind from the opinions of others.

Then, encouraged by a single word from Nozomi, her talented friend Yatsu enrolls as a rival. Witnessing her friend's rapid rise to prominence soon after enrolling, Nozomi's frustration and disappointment at her lack of improvement reach their limits.

On her way home, packing her artwork, which she has nowhere to put, she encounters a mysterious woman with blonde hair and shining piercings.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

198678.description:
Ichii is a socially awkward, extremely introverted exorcist. While she longs to quit her job as an exorcist, she makes ends meet through day trading. One day, Aoi, a bubbly, Heisei-era gal JK, shows up to help her!

Pushed by Aoi, Ichii and her friends take on their final job, but the location turns out to be... a night pool!??! A girls' comedy about polar opposites!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: #うちらが最強 ～陰キャ除霊師とギャルJK～
title.romaji: #Uchira ga Saikyou: Inkya Joreishi to Gyaru JK

198679.description:
Niimi Yoshiko is an idol who shines brightly in the Showa era pop music scene. Tono Kanade, a Reiwa era female college student who worships her, leads an enthusiastic life of supporting her idol despite the limited supply. One day, Kanade meets a woman who resembles Yoshiko. This woman is the very Niimi Yoshiko she admired, 40 years later.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: タイムマシンはお呼びでない！

198680.description:
The best of friends... ❤ who even share their first time together! ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in WEEKLY Kairakuten Vol.53

synonyms: Touch me more with your command

title.native: 君のことばでもっと触れて
title.romaji: Kimi no Kotoba de Motto Furete

198684.description:
The lonely white lioness queen of the land of beastmen meets a lovely young human slave... and decides to keep him as a pet...!?

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: L'animal de compagnie préféré de sa Majesté

198685.description:
One cold winter day, Eun-Oh gets caught robbing a man who came into the mountains and gets beaten up. Eun-Oh cries and begs the man to spare his life, saying he'll do anything for him. But that very day, he's captured by the man and forced into slavery... Chae Yun-Sa, who finds the world repulsive, and Eun-Oh, who knows nothing about it. The story of how a coincidence on Mount Moak becomes inevitability. Their winter, spring, summer, fall, and back to winter.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

198686.description:
A drinking game unfolds among friends who have just become adults. Hyun-Oh, hoping to kiss his crush Hee-Won, participates in the game of spin the bottle, but the person the bottle points to is the devilishly gay Yu-Ra. Hyun-Oh tries to end the game with a quick kiss to ease the embarrassment, but Yu-Ra unexpectedly thrusts into a deep kiss. From that day on, Hee-Won's mind constantly wanders to Yu-Ra's lips, and he even begins to dream about having sex with him...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

198688.description: Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MIMK-258) was released on January 1st, 2026.

title.native: 妻が寝取られている事を俺は知っている
title.romaji: Tsuma ga Netorarete Iru Koto wo Ore wa Shitte Iru

title.native: 反抗的な息子の嫁に催眠かけてみた
title.romaji: Hankouteki na Musuko no Yome ni Saimin Kakete mita

198691.description: Though his mother was an Omega, the new transfer student’s build left no doubt—Seol Daeyoung looked every inch a dominant Alpha. To survive, Jaemin had spent his whole life pretending to be an Alpha, and from the start he despised Seol Daeyoung. That piercing gaze Daeyoung fixed on him was the first time Jaemin had ever felt the overwhelming force of an Alpha’s stare after realizing he was truly an Omega. Instead of an Alpha’s pheromones, Daeyoung only smelled faintly of cheap fabric softener. When Jaemin refused to shake his hand, Daeyoung simply rested it on Jaemin’s shoulder with a pat. From the very day they met at eighteen—when fists flew between them—Daeyoung never missed a chance to torment Jaemin. But now, five years later, their relationship is beginning to change…

198693.description:
A simple clerk and customer routine becomes a rhythm neither wants to lose. In-Ha’s concern becomes habit, and Jae-On waits for it like breath. Convinced a beta cannot draw an alpha’s eye, he uses a pill that mimics omega traits. Affection grows, but so does the strain of a bond built on pretense.

(Source: Manta)

198710.description:
The Ichii family has two close sisters. Karin has been taking care of her younger sister Kurumi since they were little, in place of their busy parents. However, as soon as her younger sister becomes independent, she starts to lose sight of what she should be doing...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 人は獣の恋を知らない
title.romaji: Hito wa Kemono no Koi wo Shiranai

198712.description:
"Please don't leave me."

After his family is slaughtered and his country is laid to ruins, Luciano, the prince of a grieved nation, turns into a demon of vengeance. After all the evil deeds he commits, he finally faces the queen of the enemy country, Alana. Rather than begging for life, on the contrary, she pleads for her own death. Luciano, who has been stripped of his pleasure, forcibly embraces Alana and tries to make her suffer. However, as they spend more time together, his hatred turns into obsession and he begins to desire a future with her... choosing to keep her alive for revenge. With that excuse, Luciano indulges in Alana, yet she still desires for an end...

A prince of vengeance and a queen who wishes for death, what is the future of the two trapped in their terrifying past?

(Source: East Press, translated)

title.native: わがまま石油王子をわからせたい

198714.description:
Lavielle's life turned upside down when she lost her entire family. With nowhere to go, when a kind marquess offered to take her in, she was more than grateful...until she learned it came at a price. Forced to endure nightly torment, Lavielle begs for someone-anyone-to save her. Her prayers are answered when Lucien appears, claiming to be the Marquess's son... But is he truly who he says he is? Can he really be trusted? And, most of all, can Lavielle finally tempt her salvation?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.native: 私を救わないでください

synonyms: When I Fed the Quiet Gyaru Next to Me...

title.native: 隣の席の無口ギャルに餌付けしたら
title.romaji: Tonari no Seki no Mukuchi Gal ni Ezuke Shitara

title.native: トロける溺愛シュガー
トロける溺愛リミット

198718.description:
Notes:
- Chapter 1 was previously released as a one-shot in the Akuyaku BL (悪役BL) anthology.
- Includes one extra chapter and the one-shots "Torokeru Dekiai Limit (トロける溺愛リミット)" previously published in DKxBL: schoolevent, and "Kubiwa Hitotsu ni Amakami Futatsu (首輪ひとつに甘噛みふたつ)" previously published in Dom/Sub Universe BL (Dom/SubユニバースBL).

198719.description:
Adrian Vernity would only ever scowl at his classmate Liz Plomento whenever he saw her. So imagine Liz's shock when she wakes up 5 years in the future, married to Adrian! Not only that, as Emperor and Empress, they are expected to consummate their marriage. Can Liz find a way out of this royal mess?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: อนาคตพบรัก

198721.description: Manga adaptation of Bakin Takizawa's 1800s epic novel "Nansou Satomi Hakkenden".

198722.description: Manga adaptation of Maurice Leblanc's "Arsène Lupin".

198723.description:
1-3. Abunai Doyoubi (アブナイ土曜日)
4. Toshishita no Otoko no Ko (年下の男のコ)
5. Coming Out! (カミングアウト！)
6. Pinkie
7. Aromatherapy (アロマテラピー)
8. Kekkon Banzai!! (結婚万歳‼︎)

198724.description:
If you fall down that hill, you will die within three years. It was on that hill, where such a superstition still lingers, that I met the person most important to me... Winner of the Comic Bridge Monthly Award, Honorable Mention! A girl-meets-girl story that evokes the excitement and pain of youth!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

198725.description:
A girl draws a picture of her beloved with a sad look on her face as she moves her brush.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

198729.description:
Gyeong-Won Cha, who has Highlander syndrome, always wanted to look more like an adult. But one day, he hears:

"We gotta use the only advantage we've got - to pretend we're kids!"

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)
synonyms: メス支配～小さなご主人様に絶対従順～

198731.description:
1. Honnou (本能)
2. Kare wa Shiranai (彼は知らない)

4. Bad Cure
5. Kyouizon (狂依存)
6. Nest (ネスト)
7. Drunk x Drunk (ドランク×ドランク)

198732.description:
An anthology of one-shot stories featuring “devilish men.” Mysterious and young beauties, alluring stepfathers, capricious genius actors... Succumb to their irresistible charm and enchanting allure. Experience encounters with these men who will make you obsessed from the manga magazine Harta.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

1. Shishi Sousou (シシソウソウ) by Sawako Arashiyama
2. Usubeni (うすべに)
3. Kaori, Omae no Mune to Sono Ai ni (カオリ、お前の胸とその愛に) by Mariko Kikuchi
4. Seibo no Shoumei (聖母の証明) by Hirohito Kino

198733.description: Note: Includes the one-shots "Hone to Kawa to ga Hanareru Oto (ほねとかわとがはなれるおと)" and "mouth to mouse", and one extra chapter.

198735.description:
Kuze Ryuto, a second-year university student and top student in his department, decides to arrange for a nude model for a figure drawing assignment. But the nude model who shows up on the day is Kurosaki Arata, a popular guy is known for never taking his clothes off in public...!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

198736.description:
When he was a child, Ritsuki brought home a kitten and named it "Tama". He spent his days raising the cute ball of fluff only for it to take the form of a young beast-man who goes by the name of "Shuri". However, as they become high schoolers, Ritsuki mysteriously starts to distance himself from Shuri who had always been by his side...

(Source: Tokyomangasha, translated)

198737.description:
"My underwear was stolen!"

With Fuyuki's beautiful face, he's used to being touched and harassed by creepy men. Eventually, things take a drastic turn and he finds out he has a stalker! And not just any stalker, one with an underwear fetish! When Fuyuki asks his best friend Hiroto to pretend to be his boyfriend in order to scare the stalker away, Hiroto gladly obliges. He's been secretly in love with Fuyuki ever since the day he saved him from a creeper on the train. Then, one day at Fuyuki's house, he comes face to face with evidence that his stalker might be lurking around outside. In a moment of desperation, Fuyuki tells Hiroto to kiss him, as they attempt to scare the stalker away. In the heat of the moment Hiroto admits that he wants more, but what will happen next? Find out in this romantic boy's love mystery...!!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: シークレット・アンダーベール

198738.description:
"Are we actually dating...?"
When he pretends to have amnesia, the guy he hates starts acting like his boyfriend?!

College seniors Maho and Yuma bicker so much that their classmates call them an old married couple. Upon waking up in the hospital after a nasty fall, Maho decides to get revenge by pretending to forget who Yuma is, only for Yuma to tell him that the two of them are going out! Just when Maho is about to tell Yuma to knock it off, Yuma suddenly begins cuddling up to him like a loving partner. As panic begins to set in about Yuma's extreme transformation, Yuma pushes him down onto the bed with a practiced expression "like he always does"... But they really were on bad terms, right...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 嘘だとしても愛してる
title.romaji: Uso da to Shite mo Aishiteru

198739.description:
If you've been together for 500 years, of course you'd crave some excitement! These are the various stories of a human man and a male elf. Gilmier, an elf with a long life, falls in love with the human Sol and promises to watch over his beloved throughout his reincarnations. Even in their 500th year together, they are as deep in love as ever, but... they're stuck in a rut! In search of excitement that rivals their initial spark, Gilmier suggests breaking up with Sol, as he's sure their time apart would fuel their fire. However, upon hearing this, the ever-so-sweet and gentle Sol starts to show his rough side for the first time...

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Lovestruck Elf Yearns for More
title.native: 恋するエルフは刺激がほしい
title.romaji: Koisuru Elf wa Shigeki ga Hoshii

198740.description:
It is said that once every few hundred years, a dragon takes a bride and continues the bloodline. This is the story of such a dragon and a human. Money is more important than sex appeal! Aisha is working tirelessly to pay off her parents' debts. As she works hard today, she is suddenly loved at first sight by a handsome prince-like man ☆ He even tells her, "From today, you are the Dragon God's bride" --!? A contract marriage between a scheming dragon and a poor girl!? An oriental interspecies love story ♪

(Source: Rimacomi Plus, translated)

title.native: 黒龍さまの見習い花嫁

198741.description:
Going on a long drive with friends is fun. But if you try camping, it'll be even more fun! Camping food can be so delicious when eaten outdoors!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: はじめてのキャンプさん

198742.description:
Ever since she was a child, Sakura has loved horses more than anything! She enrolls in Narita Agricultural High School, which has a newly established department of horse breeding to raise thoroughbreds, and there she meets Satsuki. Along with Shion, whose grandfather is a horse owner, and Miyako, whose family runs a horse ranch in Kumamoto, Sakura runs through her youth in a land rich in nature.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Sarabure: A High School Girl's Horse-Raising Diary

title.native: さらぶれ～女子高生のウマ育成日記～
title.romaji: Sarabure: Mesukousei no Uma Ikusei Nikki

198743.description:
Han-Eul, exhausted from a long job search, is suddenly visited by a stranger who introduces himself as "God."

"God" says that if he works as Han-Eul's representative for a certain period of time, he will be released and help him land a job at the company of his choice. Having experienced various strange things, Han-Eul begins to worry. Is he really God? Even if he isn't God, is there anything he can do if it's not this? After all, isn't someone who seems so kind a bad person? Amidst the confusion, one thing is certain: the person before him is no ordinary human. So, should he pretend to be crazy just for once and believe?

"Representative... How does that work?"

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

198744.description:
The Kingdom of Terossa is home to the discriminated Hoans, physically modified super soldiers. Rezaric, commander and the strongest Hoan, leads the kingdom to victory in the recent war, only to be sentenced to death. But when he accepts his fate, he's saved by the frail Princess Delmore and brought to her lab, where she promises to aid his escape. There, Rezaric learns more about his savior and even discovers a dangerous truth that will change his life and Terossa forever...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: แด่องค์หญิงผู้หนึ่ง

198750.description:
Graduation is just around the corner. Only a little while longer for them to call themselves active high school girls. The days of their youth are remembered, filled with loneliness, sadness, and regret. What exactly is the "graduation ceremony" that signals the end of those tiresome days as high school girls? The innocent Goda, Matsuda from the track and field club, Tajima who lives by inertia, Sanada the honor student, Kaneko and Kariya who hate school. This is an innocent yet grotesque coming-of-age story about the graduation of six high school girls.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

198751.description:
A high school girl inherits her grandmother's estate—only to find a massive mansion and a staff of maids awaiting her! It turns out her grandmother was a "witch," and the maids are all non-human beings: werewolves, vampires, succubi, Medusas…

Experience the sweet romance between a young lady and her maids, unfolding in the mansion and at school, alongside various supernatural girls.
synonyms: The Witch's Granddaughter and Seven Maids

title.native: 魔女の孫と七人のメイド
title.romaji: Majo no Mago to Shichinin no Maid

198752.description:
Hwa-Seon, who desperately sought to overcome his severe appearance complex by saving up money, visits a plastic surgery clinic. Driven to despair by the annoying low-balance alarm, he visits a loan shark, his last hope. There, he meets a handsome, angelic-looking man named Shi-Gyeon.

"Even if I have to go, I have to lend him money at least once."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

198753.description:
My family is uncomfortable. I hate my older brother. Just like this... I wish I could disappear. Jeong In-Hye, a freshman in the Department of Fine Arts, is experiencing a hectic freshman year with her roommate, Ahn Soo-Jin. Soo-Jin enjoys campus life without any worries, but as she spends more time with him, In-Hye begins to feel inferior, reliving trauma from her past family. She struggles to maintain her daily life with her passion for art, but an inexplicable surge of impulse only alienates her from those around her. Ryu Mu-Yeong, a classmate who seems to see through her inner self, tries to get closer to her... but campus life is mired in love, hate, and obsession. Amidst this, a black-and-white psychodrama races to find light: "Perhaps... This Is a Form of Love?"

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.native: お嬢さまと犬 契約婚のはじめかた
title.romaji: Ojou-sama to Inu Keiyaku Kon no Hajime Kata

198755.description:
A girl who is cheated by a jerk man, in the middle of the night, accidentally discovers that the president who can see through people's hearts is a monster?! Whenever she gets along with the president, the memory fragments in her mind will slowly piece together! Why is she the only one the CEO can't read? Who is the mysterious mermaid in the dream? Turns out the truth is...

(Source: WebComics)

198756.description:
Sold off as a male bride to Marquis Oderic, who rules over the territory of Trufinnen, Everard expects to be treated as a prsioner—but in Oderic’s quiet care, he finds peace and freedom. Can love blossom in these austere halls?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

title.english: In the Hall of the Mountain King

198757.description:
One day, Sakura, a high school girl devoted to her beloved ballet, drowns in the sea where her mother died after hearing a voice. When Sakura wakes up, she finds herself somewhere other than the present day...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

198758.description:
His feelings for his best friend changed from platonic into romantic. Ainosuke could no longer suppress his feelings for his classmate and best friend, Hibe. Determined to confess today, Ainosuke dozes off at school and dreams of having sex with Hibe for some reason...!

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: One More Time, Because I Love You

title.native: 愛おしいからもう一度

198759.description:
Vivian wakes up as a dying villainess, engaged to a cursed prince feared across the continent. Her only goal is to escape the tragic fate she knows is coming, but the more she tries to stay out of the story, the deeper she's pulled into it. And the closer she gets to the prince, the more he misreads her intentions. Now caught between survival and obsession, Vivian must navigate a romance she never asked for.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

title.english: That's Not What My Will Said
title.native: 遺書を残して隠居するつもりがなぜか溺愛されてます
title.romaji: Isho wo Nokoshite Inkyosuru Tsumori ga Naze ka Dekiaisaretemasu

198760.description:
Rebecca once believed her husband, Count Zeppelin Devonshire, truly loved her. However, that changed when he took in a second wife and left Rebecca to die. Now she’s back in the past, once again his beautiful countess that he meticulously trapped in a suffocating life for their entire marriage. Fully aware of how he drove her to isolation and ruin, she’s determined to escape his cage and exact her revenge on him. With the help of Duke Julian Johannes, Rebecca is about to teach her captor what it’s like to be captured and destroyed.

(Source: Tappytoon)

198761.description:
After years in the criminal underworld, Dao Tongda faces death with nothing to show for his life except a handful of coins. But the heavens grant him an impossible miracle when he wakes up in the body of his 18-year-old self. Reuniting with old friends at the Guanghua Road Fixer Agency, he sets out to claim the power and wealth that once escaped him. But in a world ruled by blood and betrayal, can Tongda rewrite his fate and claim the throne of the night? Or is history doomed to repeat itself?

(Source: Tapas)

198763.description:
A scandalous text meant for an ex-boyfriend mistakenly lands Seo-Hae in hot water with her handsome, cold boss. His ultimatum — a contract marriage for his dying grandmother. Caught between office friction and unexpected family warmth, she navigates a bewildering path toward an unforeseen love.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: I Didn't Mean to Send That, Sir!

198764.description:
Luna, who has been reincarnated as a succubus, ends up having sex with Noel, an exorcist. Due to a one-night stand with a work colleague in her past, Luna believes that her relationships are purely physical, devoid of any emotional connection... Even though she thinks of their sex as nothing more than as feeding, Luna’s expression as she succumbs to the pleasure is incredibly provocative.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Note: Released at Comiket 106.
synonyms: 有隱情的驅魔師與轉生魅魔的致命戀情

title.native: ワケアリ退魔師は転生サキュバスと死を賭けた恋をする
title.romaji: Wakeari Taimashi wa Tensei Succubus to Shi wo Kaketa Koi wo Suru

198765.description:
Akane wants to keep her cool around her boyfriend, but that’s difficult when she’s sexually inexperienced. When she confides in her home tutor, he says that all she has to do is get used to sex, and who’s a better practice partner than this old man?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 106, 107.

title.native: 爆乳優等生に必要なちんぽのお勉強
title.romaji: Bakunyuu Yuutousei ni Hitsuyouna Chinpo no wo Benkyou

198766.description:
Notes:
• Released at Comiket 106.
• A live-action AV adaptation (START-397) was released on 27th October, 2025.

title.native: ウチの担当アイドルがエロすぎて困る
title.romaji: Uchi no Tantou Idol ga Ero Sugite Komaru

198770.description:
Saya suddenly loses a year's worth of memories. She begins living with her guardian, a man called Touji, but she can't shake the feeling that there's something off about who she used to be...

Note: Published in LaLa DX May 2024 issue.

title.native: 孤高なカノジョと、彼女の部屋でシてること
title.romaji: Kokou na Kanojo to, Kanojo no Heya de Shiteru Koto

title.native: 友達以上浮気未満のカノジョたち
title.romaji: Tomodachi Ijou Uwaki Miman no Kanojo-tachi

Cover Illustration: Akira Caskabe

12. TOBI'S TIME [JIN]

title.native: ごしゅじん様しか勝たん！ライトBLアンソロジー ～ぼくたちケダモノご主人の恋見守り隊～
title.romaji: Goshujin-sama shika Katan! Light BL Anthology: Bokutachi Kedamono Goshujin no Koi Mimamori-tai

title.native: ボクとおば〜のフシギな話
title.romaji: Boku to Obaa no Fushigi na Hanashi

198775.description: This is a collection of four short stories about love.

title.native: それでも天使のままで

198776.description:
In a world still engulfed in war, Theo, who serves as a military lieutenant, feels uncomfortable around Kaguma, the captain of another unit, who constantly hits on him. However one day, while shielding Theo from a sniper, Kaguma sustains an arm injury that takes a month to heal. Feeling responsible, Theo offers to nurse Kaguma for the month until he recovers, but when he witnesses Kaguma masturbating, Theo ends up helping him deal with "that" as well...?

(Source: Cosmic Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

198777.description:
Princess Loutier of the Kingdom of Florella, Lou, was called the "Flower Princess" for she had a magical power to make flowers bloom through her song.

It was a power that royals of Florella possess, but hers was especially powerful. That is why she was always told not to use her power... it was too powerful that once she harmed someone when she was little. Lou didn't know about love, but she felt happy when Prince Raynaud of the allied kingdom asked her to marry him. However, on the day of the wedding, the Olgan Empire invaded Florella... Lou was captured by Prince Julius, a mysterious masked prince.

Lou marries Prince Julius. She wants to hate him... but there is something soft in his heart that she can't ignore. Is this first love?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Captured Flower Princess's Happy Miscalculation
title.native: とらわれ花姫の幸せな誤算
title.romaji: Towarare Hanahime no Shiawase na Gosan

198778.description:
Ash, reincarnated as a mob character in an otome game, finds the girl Fienne crouching in a rainy alleyway. Ash didn't recognize her at first, but when he remembered that she was supposed to be the main heroine, he finds out that they have already been thrown off on the route to the bad ending—!?

198783.description:
The year is 2060, and the world has seen advanced AI replace countless jobs, widening the gap between rich and poor. Takeru lives in a low-class slum known as the "Downtown District." He plays basketball on the streets every day with his friends Isaiah and Bon, aiming to reach the pinnacle of basketball, the NBA. Then, he learns that NBA tryouts are being held for the first time in 13 years...!?

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

A forensic mystery in which a solitary genius anatomist and a rookie detective who can see spirits team up to investigate various cases.

198791.description:
A hilarious comedy about an immigrant family filled with laughter and humanity!

An old-fashioned, clumsy man has arrived in a town where the sea breeze blows.

Everything about him is nonsense. His name is Aozora Kanjiro. He's a professional baseball player with three children.

On the verge of being scrapped, this "pinch hitter" stirs up a storm in his new home ground...!?

(Source: Big Comic Bros, translated)

title.native: バックホームブルース

198792.description:
In this approximation of another world, human-controlled fighters compete in the annual Cosmetics Awards, aiming to commercialize the aesthetic techniques (cosmetics) they wear, gain funding, and gain status. Fighter Noel is a boy with no ambition or motivation, and no sense of purpose in life. But when he meets Farmer, a dropout girl who works at a low-cost manufacturer but is constantly scolded for "lacking aesthetic sense," Noel takes another step into the glittering world of fighting. As their thoughts clash, the three-legged battle begins!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

This anthology from Monthly Shonen Champion, the super wholesome boys' comic magazine, features seven slightly naughty stories about our "boobs"! Big breasts, beautiful breasts, bowl-shaped breasts, and huge breasts! Yes! "Boobs" make us happy!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

198797.description:
Ichinose Hanako is 45, a full-time housewife living in a rural town. Despite daily frustrations, she lives a fairly happy life. One day, she sees her vocational school classmate, Mizuki Urara, appearing on television as a novelist. 27 years ago, the three of them, including another classmate, Hiraizumi Kanon, were hanging out together; she vaguely dreamed of becoming something, but Urara rejected her hopes and they had a falling out... What action did Hanako take, overcome by jealousy as she compared the past and present? A friendship that broke when they were 18 troubles the hearts of three people now 45 years old.

(Source: Biccomi, translated)
synonyms: At 45, our sparkle is a glimmer

198798.description:
“I can’t… No more… I’m going to die…”

Hana Yamada is trapped in a hellish life of nonstop work, until one day, her savior comes by and announces… “I’m going to lock you up.”

Turns out, Hana has a beautiful stalker—and she’s loaded! Trapped in a huge mansion with gourmet meals and an open-air bath, Hana’s new life of luxury begins!

(Source: Manga UP!)

198799.description: Keitarou, dreaming of a soulmate, meets a beautiful brown girl (?) Sun. Apparently, he'd promised to marry Sun when they were young — and it turns out he's a prince of the kingdom of Caglionia! Will they find their soulmate in each other!?

Prince Sun Wanna Be a Wife

198800.description:
I was out shopping for books one day when I was suddenly attacked! But a heaven-sent woman by the name of Chrisya Saldo took it upon herself to save me. She's beautiful, strong, and independent--I want to see her thrive, but she's being forced to marry to save her family business. I can't let some man lock her away--I am Diane of House Harp! My mother is a marquess! I have resources, I have money! Don't worry--I'll save you, my angel!

(Source: Tapas)

198802.description:
Oswald Quinton, heir to a powerful military company, is well-known for his successful career but also for his brutal personality, a result of his troubled childhood. As Oswald discovers the significance of "Amon," a mineral crucial for his company's survival, he ventures to strike a deal with the landowner who possesses the land containing the vital resource. Initially resistant to selling, the landowner finally agrees under one condition: Oswald must help the landowner's daughter, Yoo Dan-Hee, rediscover the joys of life. Dan-Hee, scarred by her failed marriage, has lost her ability to love. As their paths converge, how will their relationship evolve?

(Source: Tappytoon)

On the night of the slave hunt, Paya, a girl who lost her mother, becomes a voodoo priest and embarks on a path of revenge.

(Source: Naver, translated)

198805.description:
When Souta begins working at his relative’s gym he reunites with his cousin and first crush Minamo. It looks like she hasn’t changed at all, but Souta finds out that she does more than just manage the gym…

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 103

Da Bo-Young (24 years old), an unemployed person who only liked bears and knew how to see ghosts, had a problem with putting anything edible in her mouth. No matter what, who would have thought that little thing was the spirit of Ungnyeo? Huh? But things are getting more and more serious...? But don't worry, Ungnyeo can tear evil spirits apart!

(Source: Naver, translated)

198808.description:
Kyo is a college student living alone in Tokyo, completely absorbed in making rap beats. One day, his childhood friend Mana from back home shows up at his door. As they suddenly find themselves living together, Kyo must confront both his conflicted feelings and his music.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: アオバ自転車店 ケイリンチャレンジ編

198815.description:
In a near-future Japan where humanoid AI robot technology has become commonplace, these robots have become a familiar presence in everyday life. This era introduces the "Rental Person Service", a system that provides temporary family members, lovers, maids, and more for set periods.

(Source: Shounen Gahosha, translated)

198816.description: Manga adaptation of Robert Louis Stevenson's 1886 work "Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde."

198817.description:
Mimei shares the hobby of listening to a late-night comedy radio show with the funny and mysterious Kurage from his class. And she's famous for sending in hilarious comments that are read on the show? But Mimei wants to be just as funny as her! Are they friends, are they rivals, are they something more...? This radio rom-com is on the air!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Winner of the 2026 Next Manga Award in the Print Manga Category.
synonyms: ซัมวัน เฮิรตซ์

198818.description:
Hisashi Kunomiya slipped into the abandoned hotel at midnight, ready to end it all, when the sound of a guitar suddenly broke the silence. There in the darkness, a girl played alone...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: When You Play the Last Chord
title.native: ラストコードは君の手で

198819.description:
Inami, whose older brother doesn't go to school, and Kiyokawa, whose older sister doesn't go to school, both became the class pet caretakers when they were in fifth grade. Each carrying their own burdens, the two had supported each other through their daily lives. But then one day, an unexpected incident occurs…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

198820.description:
After school, you're only mine! A BL series about the sweet after-school lives of teachers and high school boys!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

198821.description:
The long-awaited comic adaptation of Cobalt Bunko's hit series!

Princess Diamond, who was shunned because of her beauty, heads to the Forest of Despair, where a beast lives. A terrifying beast and a princess to sacrifice, but the two fall in love. With a kiss of promise, the beast's spell is broken and a handsome prince appears, but...?!

After hearing that Prince Georald has been caught up in a conspiracy, Diamond decides to set out on a journey with him - a thrilling fantasy filled with love and adventure!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: ちょー美女と野獣～キスしたら王子様になっちゃったので、もう一度魔法をかけなくちゃ～

198822.description:
Shotaro Matsunaga (Shou-chin) has just enrolled at Kanagawa Prefectural Teru High School. He was looking forward to high school life, but he struggled to fit in with his classmates and found himself feeling alone.Then, popular classmate Yuta Yoshida (Babylon) spoke to him. The two share similar interests and quickly become best friends, aiming to become the best after-school club members...!?

A youthful friendship comedy about two "lifelong middle schoolers"!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: かがやけ! ミラクルボーイズ

198823.description:
Otani Yorika (14) was a supporting character in his own life. After living such miserable days, Yorika committed suicide, only to find that an unexpected fate awaited him: becoming the demon king's pet in another world!?

"I'll defeat the demon king, gain my freedom, and finally become the protagonist of my own life!"

Yorika made this decision, and then a tiny demon girl appeared before him, with sturdy sheep's horns, moonlight-colored hair, and sparkling crimson eyes.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 魔王少女はパンケーキの夢を見る。
title.romaji: Maou Shoujo wa Pancake no Yume wo Miru

198824.description:
"I love you so much I want to eat you."

Naruo Yurie is a student who can see non-human "black figures." On the day he meets his Tokyo landlord, Taka Mitora, Naruo is attacked by the "black figure" but is saved by a white tiger. From that day on, mysterious incidents begin to occur around Naruo...!?

This is a story of love and desire between a divine beast and a human.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 談虎色変-虎を談じて色変ず-
title.romaji: Danko Shikihen: Tora wo Danjite Irohenzu

198825.description:
"The Mature Idol Project"

The latest project proposed by Manpuku Etertainment productions, in a bid to revive the company. Experienced in the successes and failures of the business world, 6 middle-aged men now face the many hurdles of age and physical ability, whilst pursuing their goal to become idols. In an effort to prove that old dogs can learn new tricks, and that you can still learn to shine no matter your age. These middle-aged men, and the end of their ropes, are taking a stand!

(Source: Fuji Creative)

198826.description:
There are places in Japan you should never go to. Mei and Hibiki are sisters who grew up near Mount Fuji's "Sea of ​​Trees." While helping their childhood friend, Teru, move, they discover a strange box, which triggers a series of mysterious phenomena around the sisters...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

198827.description:
Haruma ends up taking part in a mysterious game in place of his best friend. The prize for the winner is 100 million yen. The conditions for participation are: 1) you must be desperate for the money; 2) you can stay out overnight without telling your parents; 3) you must not tell anyone; 4) you don't mind that the loser's life may not be guaranteed.

Haruma heads to the venue, but is locked in with the other participants. "I won't lose!" "I'll definitely win!" the boys and girls cried with gleam in their eyes. There can only be one winner. Will Haruma survive this survival game?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

198828.description:
"1 billion won, loan approved."

A large loan is deposited into the account of a father who has decided to commit suicide, claiming it's for a future bank account. It's unclear when the money will arrive or where it will come from. One thing is certain: the moment the deposit is made, his life will plunge into an irreversible hell.

(Source: Naver, translated)

198829.description:
Following the death of the emperor, the prestigious Hoshi family of the Golden Blossom Empire has decided that all members must commit suicide. Yuukei, the frail heir of the Hoshi family, is also among those targeted, but he narrowly escapes. But now he is being pursued...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 後宮に星は宿る〜金椛国春秋〜
title.romaji: Koukyuu ni Hoshi wa Yadoru: Kinkakoku Shunjuu

198830.description:
Throw your all into love, fun, and youth!!!

Desperate to give his all to youth, Misaki takes inspiration from the gal game "Spring Love MEMORY" and declares to his friends that he absolutely wants a girlfriend while he still has free time in his second year of high school...

A slapstick coming-of-age story brought to you by high schoolers at the age where they're in love with love!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synonyms: Mr. BL Sommelier, Please Choose Books for Me!

title.native: おしえて! BLソムリエお兄さん

198832.description:
Shortly after entering school, Shibao Masayuki is forced by his classmates to take on the role of "death officer." "What does it mean to be in charge of the deaths...!?" Shibao is confused, but Fujimi Sorako, who is also in charge, explains to him. "The death officer is in charge of taking care of ■■■." As he wanders the school building at night with Fujimi, he meets ■■ and their strange and mysterious duties as officers begin...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

198833.description: The Earth was destroyed by a giant meteorite and the only humans left behind were the "evil scientist" Noir and the "Saint Warrior" Mirei, enemies who once fought over the Earth. As Mirei tries to carry out justice in a desperate situation, Noir suggests, "Let's create a new planet by having children". While Mirei tries to decline the enemy's unexpected suggestion, it doesn't seem to be that bad altogether...?

title.native: 滅亡世界で悪の科学者と愛を育まないといけないようです
title.romaji: Metsubou Sekai de Aku no Kagakusha to Ai wo Hagukumanai to Ikenai you desu

198834.description:
As the talented leader of the ESG team at Soya Group., Minsu always leaves work on time. However, his work life takes a dramatic turn when the daughter of the chairman joins his team. The ESG team gets entangled in the power struggle between the higher-ups, and Minsu’s overqualified abilities put his team in the eye of the storm. Can Minsu protect his off-hours from all this corporate chaos?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Art of Leaving Work on Time

198835.description:
The story is set in 2020. Mamoru, an indoorsy second-year high school student, has a crush on Aya, the pretty girl who lives next door. However, Aya is moving out due to adult reasons. Not wanting to be separated from her, Mamoru musters up his courage and proposes a plan to run away from home.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Gekijouban Anime Bokura no Nanokakan Sensou

198836.description:
With summer vacation just beginning, all the boys in Class 2, Year 1 at a Tokyo junior high school, disappear. They barricade themselves in an abandoned factory, declare it a liberated zone, and launch a rebellion against the adults!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

198837.description:
In a world where a mysterious illness, Occupational Disease, is known to drive people who are too skilled at their jobs insane, government officials dubbed "Shigoto Osame" have been appointed to "treat" those affected.

High school student Shimizu Shizuku lives with one such Shigoto Osame, Kuujo, who just so happens to be the one who "treated" his own parents. While he absolutely loathes Kuujo for taking his parents from him, once various mysterious incidents begin to happen around them Shimizu has no choice but to count on the other man for help.

title.native: シゴトオサメ-職業病事件帳-

198838.description:
Princess Martina of the Moran Empire met her fitting end as everyone expected, losing everything from her throne to her precious daughter Lily, a sacred guardian beast key to the empire's power. Reborn with a second chance, this former villainess faces an impossible quest: collecting kisses from heroes across her realm to protect everything she holds dear. But these heroes have their own agenda, asking to become the father of her child. Between plotting revenge and navigating messy romance, this bloodthirsty princess will stop at nothing for her daughter and revenge.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: とぅ君とあたしの八千日間
title.romaji: Tou-kun to Atashi no Hachi Sen-kakan

198841.description: In the devastated city of Kyoto, color-coded gangs battle it out over the right to rule the city. A young man on a search for the brother who disappeared from his life three years ago becomes involved in this conflict.

title.native: キョウト彩奪ギャングスタア

198842.description:
There's no limit to how trashy these guys are...!!

They keep going until they get told off...! Ninomae, a teaching assistant, is tasked with teaching in place of the professor, but the class he's assigned to is filled with three incredibly trashy male students: Chihiro, Tsuruyoshi, and Reo...!? A free-spirited comedy set in an art university!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.romaji: Kuzu x Kiri Danshi: Oretachi no Caste Sai Kasou Life

198844.description:
An other-dimensional labyrinth of gourmet food and love!? Five years ago, the Demon King died. Now, in Tsukitaka City, there is a retro coffee shop run by a tough-looking manager. The manager, Don-san, is a former Demon King. He runs the shop with part-time worker Akari and barista Isamu (a former hero). However, the customers are all adventurers who visit with troubles, and the place of relaxation is constantly in turmoil, with the three staff members constantly getting caught up in it! And the manager's past becomes a disaster that slowly begins to affect the town...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: It initially began serialization on the author's Twitter as "Nekomimi Kissa no Manga" on August 1, 2023. It was later acquired by Kadokawa who published the first volume on July 12, 2024.
synonyms: ネコミミ喫茶のまんが

198845.description: The third and final season of Treasure Hunter.

198846.description:
The strongest weapon ordered from the future has arrived.

Kim Jun, director of the Agency for Defense Development. In 2024, after a terrorist attack, he meets a tragic end while protecting the South Korean military secret, the ADD chip. However, upon regaining consciousness, he finds himself presented with an unexpected opportunity. He is reborn in the body of his friend Jeon Hyeon-Seung, who died in 1998! Using the ADD chip implanted in his body, Kim Jun gains access to future technologies.

"If you give me the chance... I'll create it for you within three months."

Use future technology to create the ultimate weapon to overcome the IMF crisis!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: Should I Make You A Nuclear Weapon?

198847.description:
Born with a natural communication disorder, our protagonist, Junpei, dies at the age of 28, and wakes up to find himself reincarnated in the world of the game he was obsessed with in life! Junpei sets out on an adventure as a summoner to earn a living, but what awaits him there is a brutal, life-threatening battle that is completely different from the game... A heart-warming battle fantasy set in another world, depicting the growth of a man who cannot form a party due to his lack of cheat abilities and poor communication skills, as he desperately overcomes difficulties with the help of his summoned beasts!

(Source: Line Digital Frontier, translated)

title.native: コミュ障、異世界へ行く

Lingering, one-sided affections await you at home.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2025-10

"Cursed Ichimatsu-sama," who can be met by chanting a spell, is a strange living doll that will curse you on your behalf if you make a wish. But, to be honest, she doesn't really curse you that much! A doll horror comedy with slightly different kinds of scariness begins!

(Source: Young Magazine, translated)

synonyms: Telle une oasis dans le désert

198851.description:
Every night, office worker Kirin has a naughty dream. In the dream, she is a sex slave in ancient Rome, humiliated by her master. One day, her company's stunningly handsome CEO, Kimijima, declares to her, "You are my sex slave." A reincarnation love story that transcends time and space!

(Source: CMOA, translated)

This work is being published after discussions with the relevant parties, using manga data left on a used PC that was purchased by Komori Hiki-sensei. Please enjoy it without concern, no matter what events may occur in this manga.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

198872.description:
“Do you also… taste sweet?”

Maki, a model, is afflicted with a mysterious illness called “Flower Possession Disease,” where flowers grow out of the body. Worn down by overwork, he collapses right in the middle of a shoot. He flees into a deserted studio to hide, only to be discovered by Yuusei, a part-timer at a flower shop. “You still... have flowers coming out of you.” Yuusei, speaking as if he knew all about Maki, proceeds to directly devour the flowers sprouting from him. Every time the flowers that he supposedly hates are devoured, Maki feels a dark, illicit thrill...

Shiny, doglike college student x flower-possessed, tsundere beauty, a perverse and dramatic love.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Still not satisfied.

198875.description:
Kanata, whose plain and modest looks hide a surprisingly carefree attitude toward sex, hates the hassle of relationships and prefers to satisfy his needs through casual hookups. One day, while using a dating app to find another partner, he matches with Chihiro, a strikingly handsome man. Puzzled as to why someone like him would be interested, Kanata agrees to meet, only to discover that Chihiro is completely inexperienced. Guiding his awkward, hesitant touches, Kanata patiently teaches him the basics of intimacy. Their encounter ends in frustrating incompleteness, and Kanata assumes that will be the end of it… until Chihiro unexpectedly asks “Can we meet again?”

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

198877.description:
Lee Myeong-Hwa, the daughter of a fallen family, works hard as a seamstress, despite being bullied by her superiors. One day, she meets a handsome military officer at the palace and, without knowing why, ends up spending the night with him. The next day, she is ordered to become "Seigun Court Lady" (a candidate for the king's concubine)...!? The king's doting love will make your heart skip a beat! A fateful Korean fantasy!

(Source: Flex Comic, translated)

198878.description:
Myeong-Hwa, a lady-in-waiting at the palace, aims to get promoted but is the target of the hatred of her superiors. One day, she meets a handsome young military officer at the palace who proposes a strange deal to her. The next morning, she is ordered to become the king's favorite "Seigun Sangguang" and a candidate for the king's concubine!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

198879.description:
After dying in our world, Yae is reborn into a strange country called Izumo, which resembles ancient Japan, except for the fact that the supernatural is commonplace. When she is attacked by a terrifying monster called a shade, Yae has no choice but to release Arai, a golden tiger and former god, from his seal. In no time, the bossy tiger has her helping to find his brother, Sui, but it turns out that Sui has fallen ill and will soon become a monster himself. Arai, however, thinks Yae is just the person to heal his afflicted sibling… Does Yae really have what it takes to be doctor to a god?

(Source: Yen Press)

A girl who was sold by her mother and left without relatives is taken in by the boss of the most terrifying Chinese mafia. She thought her life was over, but she was taken to a luxury boutique to get clothes...?!

"Don't be mistaken. These favors from me are so that I can sell you at a high price."

A love comedy between a tough-looking boy with a sharp attitude and a cute girl with a good heart!

198883.description:
Nao has always been shy and withdrawn, making it hard for him to talk to people. For years, his best friend Keigo has stepped in and spoken for him whenever he got tongue-tied. But now Keigo is about to leave their hometown. He teases Nao, "I know everything you’re thinking," but surely he hasn't noticed Nao’s true feelings. Relying on Keigo’s kindness, Nao can't find the courage to confess. As their goodbye draws near, Keigo suddenly tells him, "I know how you feel. Since this is the last time, I want to hear it from you directly"...!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Hee-Jin and Seung-Jo were inseparable best friends for fourteen years, but one night was all it took to end their friendship. A year later, they are strangers again, separated by unspoken love and unresolved misunderstandings. When their paths cross once more, will they be able to bridge the space between them?

(Source: Manta)

198885.description:
120 years have passed since the First Emperor’s death. Venlyra, a powerful rogue and trusted herald of the Emperor, awakens from a long slumber to a crumbling empire that has strayed from the light. Once more, the Skeleton Messenger makes the rounds, bound for a decaying throne, and for the embers of a self long thought extinguished within. Hear ye, hear ye! Hark, and heed the Emperor’s words! The hour of reckoning is upon you!

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Tale of the Skeleton Messenger

198886.description:
My boyfriend was secretly planning to marry my best friend. In an instant, I lost both the person I'd promised my future to and my friend. It felt like all the misfortunes of my life had hit me at once. But then, my brother's friend, Seo-Yoon, showed up and gave my life hope.

(Source: Manta)

“Did you just leave him hard and keep drawing?”

The man pointed at the painting, his voice low.

“Were you watching me?”

Suyeon had never seen this man in reality—only in her fantasies. In those vivid, nocturnal dreams.

“I must say... even the most private parts are identical.” He stepped closer, his voice trailing off.

“Is that so? You’re saying... it’s really that big?”

(Source: Manta)

As the boss, Seongheon will do whatever it takes to keep his employees happy and productive. So, even though he definitely shouldn't look, when he gets ahold of his subordinate Minju's diary, Seongheon can't help but take a peek. To his shock, the entries are full of erotic fantasies of a man with the same name as him! Minju's private confessions are completely scandalous but, as her boss, Seongheon has a duty to keep her satisfied—even if that means getting scandalous himself!

Will Ju-Ho be able to live a normal life? Or will he be devoured by those closest to him?

Actor Min Hae-Jin, who was on the verge of retirement due to rumors of sexual harassment by a junior colleague, was offered a BL audio drama as his comeback project. His first scene recording was awkward, and his voice actor idol and co-star, Yoo Kang-Jun, approached him to offer help.
