198910.description:
Slaine spends his days living as a humble commoner in the quiet Kingdom of Hasenvalia—until the royal family is wiped out in a palace fire.

In the aftermath, Slaine discovers a secret kept from him all his life: He's the king's illegitimate son and now the sole surviving heir to the throne! Thrust into power with no training and precious few allies, Slaine must navigate court politics, earn the trust of wary nobles, and learn how to rule a kingdom he never thought would be his.

With his sharp-witted and fiercely loyal aide-de-camp Monica at his side, Slaine begins to grow into his role. But not everyone is pleased to see a commoner rising to the top. While some welcome the new king with cautious hope, others hide their true intentions behind polite smiles. As threats lurk in the shadows, young Slaine must rise to the challenge—or risk losing the crown before he ever gets to wear it.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

"I want to be okay..."

Hanada Mone spends her days practicing hard on being okay with life, and one night, she encounters a strange creature known as "Ashikawa," who also seems to be not okay. A heartwarming story of supporting each other on the path to being more "okay" with things.

"Even a mannequin has more charm than you."

It was the worst night of Kotori's life, being dumped by her lover with such cruel words. Following the break-up, she tried to drink her away her sorrows, caused by her stiff facial expressions. On her way home, she runs into a handsome man named Hijiri who can understand her feelings like a magician, and she ends up spending the night with him. The next day, Kotori meets Hijiri again at the Ink Roost Hotel, where she works as a florist. This is the start of a sweet dreamy romance that you won't want to wake up.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

In Japan during the Meiji era, various private railway networks were engaged in a fierce battle to control the development of the railways. Against this backdrop, engineer Yasujiro Shima, head of the Kansai Railway Department, and the prodigious but stubborn driver Tetsundo Amamiya both aspired to take the railways to new heights, convinced that the future of the country depended on it.

Ayumu Tada is a completely normal 58-year-old salaryman. His daughter, who loves anime, is about to get married to a man who also likes anime, and Ayumu feels distant from them because he has no interest in the medium. Suddenly, he time slips 40 years into the past, back to his 3rd year of high school! One of his classmates happens to become a famous animator in the future, and so Ayumu begins animating with him.

(Source: Shounen Gahosha, translated)

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

198931.description:
When his grandfather is suddenly brutally murdered by a member of the Demonic Martial Alliance, Fu Enxue vows that he will stop at nothing to avenge his death. To find the perpetrator, he infiltrates the alliance armed only with his wits and thirst for vengeance. There, he catches the attention of the demonic masters, as his overwhelming bloodlust makes him a prodigy in the demonic arts. But will this thirst for blood help him in his pursuit of revenge, or will that same power be his undoing?

(Source: Tapas)

198932.description:
The title story, "Canon," is the story of a boy who has lost his memory and is confused by the existence of a woman who claims to be his wife and by others who call him "Grandpa." The book also includes other stories published in Le Paradis (Hakusensha) and its online supplements, including "Ningyo," "Umizibi After," "Yume no Onna," "One's Place," "Hachisu no Hana After," and "Yakusoku."

(Source: Natalie, translated)

198933.description:
Sid, who is a Shark Princess of the underwater kingdom, falls in love with Raun, a member of the boy band BUB, and runs away to the surface to see him. Things are going great until the famous teen actor, Ji-Han Kang, steps into her life unexpectedly and they keep crossing paths. Will Sid be able to keep her secret and get what she came up to the surface for?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: ムーンシャーク～推し活してたらスターになりました!?～

title.english: Moon Shark : From Underwater Princess to Celebrity

198934.description:
For his entire life, Chae Jeong-Hyeon has lived as nothing more than a shadow, an art restorer forced into the role of hidden ghost painter for his father, the celebrated Painter Chae. When the old master dies suddenly, Jeong-Hyeon’s long-nurtured desire for revenge dies with him, leaving only despair and the urge to abandon everything. But on the edge of surrender, a stranger appears: Yeom Tae-Hwa, a man caught between mortal and divine.

Tae-Hwa offers Jeong-Hyeon a bargain. Restore what has been lost and share his roof, and in return, he will grant Jeong-Hyeon the honor stolen by his father. Reluctantly, Jeong-Hyeon agrees, clinging to the fragile hope Tae-Hwa extends. Yet as the days pass, cold obligation begins to blur into fascination. Living side by side, Jeong-Hyeon is drawn closer to Tae-Hwa’s enigma… and to the haunting secret hidden within his 200-year-old silence.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: วิวรณ์รักต้องสาป

198935.description:
Catherine Caliburn, a duke’s daughter marked by tainted blood, desperately tries to end her engagement to Grand Duke Deimos Pendragon to keep her true origins a secret, but the Grand Duke has no intention of letting her go as he seeks revenge for her betrayal in his past life.

(Source: Manta)

198936.description:
I was reborn into my favorite novel as Lelia, a tragic side character. Sent to a royal academy as a decoy, I befriend four princes fated to slay a dragon. Years later, they return as heroes, only to accuse me of murder! How can I reclaim their shattered trust?

(Source: Manta)

Ordered by the Emperor himself to wed naval officer Edward, Yelodia is disappointed to find that her fiancé has doubts about the arrangement due to their age gap. Undeterred, she sets out to win his heart—but with imperial intrigue in play, can Yelodia overcome the odds?

(Source: Manta)

There's no place like home...

Having grown up in a nursing home, Sheena wished for nothing more than to be reunited with her family. But when she finally returns home after 9 years, she finds herself feeling like a stranger in her own house as things take an eerie turn.

(Source: Manta)

198940.description:
Noh Sung-Jae, now a police officer, returns to his hometown of Maerim-myeon after being assigned there. He thought he simply had to adjust to his new life, but forgotten memories, like the deaths of his parents, begin to surface, tormenting him. Meanwhile, a "body amputation incident" linked to his parents' cult begins to repeat itself, and Jun-Hyeok and Hyun-Tae, who are hovering around Sung-Jae, become increasingly suspicious.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: 豊穣の湖には秘密がある

198941.description:
Yeokdeok Yeong-Sun, who yearns for independence activist "Bigak Kim Do-Hun," lives her life longingly! One day, a man suddenly appears in Bigak's house, recreated in a museum, and reveals himself to be Kim Do-Hun... and that she's the only one who can see, touch, and hear him?!

A sweet romance between the man who "lives" in the museum and the woman who "manages" it.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

198942.description:
Stella was never given the love of her family, nor the skills bestowed by God. After her fiance's heart was stolen by her younger sister, she rushed to a convent. She discovered the joys of cleaning and ended up becoming a maid for the troubled prince Cecil, who is holed up in a room filled with miasma. Before she knew it, she had acquired the skill of "purification"—and combined with his "destruction" skill, she transformed magical beasts into fluffy, holy beasts! Is there a secret behind Stella's origins?!

(Source: Gaugau Monster, translated)
synonyms: 아무에게도 사랑받지 못해서 바닥을 닦았더니 그곳이 성역화된 영애의 이야기

title.native: 誰にも愛されないので床を磨いていたらそこが聖域化した令嬢の話

198943.description:
"I like her... I want to take her home right now". My lewd co-worker is banging me in his thoughts. Once we're alone together, it won't end with just a fantasy...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Cold Co-worker Obsessively Loves Me
title.native: ドライな同期の溺愛癖

198944.description:
A world full of boys isn't so bad.

This essay manga loosely depicts the daily life of Conte-kun, who attended an all-boys school for six years from middle school to high school. In addition to reprints of existing works previously published on Twitter, it also includes many new drawings!

(Source: Newtype Web, translated)

Note: Originally published on the author's Twitter on May 29, 2020, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who published the first volume on March 27, 2023.

198945.description:
"Please let me write a masterpiece like no other."

Yun Sang-Yeon, an aspiring writer who prayed to the monkey paw, who grants three wishes, is falsely accused and imprisoned. After 20 years in prison, he completes his book, "The Writer in Solitary Cell," and receives recognition, but the void in his heart remains unfilled. Then, the monkey paw reappears, saying, "I still have two wishes left."

(Source: Naver, translated)

synonyms: I'm in love through the lens

198950.description:
After falling ill during a disastrous company dinner, Nagisa is rescued by Yuma, a tattoo artist with a kind heart. Overwhelmed by his kindness, Nagisa starts crying but at the same time, his body unexpectedly reacts to Yuma's presence. Seeing his distress, Yuma reaches out to help, leading to a messy, less-than-perfect first intimate encounter. Despite the awkward start, the two begin dating. Nagisa slowly finds himself drawn to Yuma's comforting warmth and genuine care?but just as he begins to fall in love, an unexpected twist threatens their fragile bond...

(Source: CLLENN)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ねぇなっちゃん、こっちむいて

198956.description:
Branded a heartless and cruel sovereign, Emperor Herace of the Tevente Empire has lost three empresses to betrayal and murder. Into his life steps Eleanor Snow, the fearless daughter of House Snow, offering herself as his new empress to protect her family from ruin. In a world of assassins, treachery, and political unrest, their alliance is forged out of necessity but eventually tempered by trust. Together, they will fight to defend the empire… and each other.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: If I May Dare to Wish

title.native: 一途な幼馴染の恋について
title.romaji: Ichizu na Osananajimi no Koi ni Tsuite

198959.description:
A man who secretly observes his beautiful sister-in-law, 'Dohyeok'. One day, 'Suji', his sister-in-law's close friend, comes to visit. However, something unexpected happens, and in this situation, the man develops a strong desire for 'Soyeok'. Trying to ignore his feelings, he finds himself increasingly drawn to her, culminating in a passionate encounter that leads to unexpected consequences...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

198960.description:
In the Joseon Dynasty, a mysterious creature called 'the ghost' haunts the capital. A young man named 'Baekin' (literally 'White Hair') encounters this ghost and, while initially frightened, becomes involved in a series of strange events. The ghost reveals a secret wish to Baekin, but its true intentions are shrouded in mystery. As Baekin gradually learns more about the ghost's past, he finds himself facing dangerous challenges and must unravel the truth behind its existence. The story follows Baekin's journey as he risks everything to help the ghost, even though its motives remain unclear. Meanwhile, Baekin's growing feelings for the ghost intensify, leading to a heart-wrenching romance...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

198961.description:
Notes:
- Originally self-published, was then compiled by Kaiohsha for commercial release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 顔から始まるハムクマくん

synonyms: 番外編＠ぐずぐず酔っぱらい

title.native: 地雷系ヘビー級ラバー

198963.description:
A popular flower shop has many male workers who are as beautiful as flowers. Hataoka Kei, one of the staff there, uses all possible methods to make his one-sided love for his high-school teacher, Umehara, comes true and now they're spending their happy days together. But he doesn’t know what the slow Umehara could be thinking, that’s why the distance between them can’t be shortened that easily...!

- Pretty perverted staff × thickheaded high-school teacher
- Heart-broken staff × earnest staff
- Coward shop manager × serious best friend
- Softhearted salesman × devilish staff

With the flower shop as the setting, the adult love stories of handsome guys blossom in profusion♡

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

198964.description:
Selena's whole world is turned upside down when Sienna, the daughter of a maid, suddenly claims that she's the real daughter of Count Estarion. Sienna remembers everything about Selena's childhood, making everyone believe that she's the real daughter. Her once supportive brother and father, who are everything to her, turn cold and kick her out of the house. Even her close friend and fiance turn their backs on her. With nowhere to go, she is saved by the only person who treats with her kindness, Eideun Calypso, a war hero who was once a lowly slave. He asks Selena to be his private tutor and teach him high society etiquette. Why is Eideun being so generous to her? Will Selena be able to find out the truth about her identity? Will she take revenge on those who betrayed her trust?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: Donc je ne suis pas la vraie Séléna ?

title.english: I Thought I Was the Real Daughter
title.native: 私が本物だと思ったのに
title.romaji: Watachi ga Honmono da to Omotta no ni

198965.description:
She once saved the world as the fearsome Archmage of Despair. Her reward? Being reborn as Lesia Elphinad, child saint and unwilling subscriber to a pay-to-live reincarnation subscription where missing a payment could cost her life. Instead of enjoying toys and naps, she must complete divine quests, collect Heaven Coins, and live under the same roof as her former rival, the powerful light mage. With the help of old friends and new, can she turn a cursed second chance into a life worth living?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: This Reincarnation Requires a Subscription Fee
This Reincarnation Comes at a Price

198967.description:
Once, she lived the life of a criminal. Now she lives a life married to her doting husband, the Beast King! His beautiful violet eyes upon her, she's warmly embraced by his large body covered in fur. But...can she trust him?

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: L'épouse sacrifiée au roi des hommes-bêtes

title.english: Sacrificed to Be the Beast King's Bride
title.native: 獣人王は生贄花嫁を罪ごと愛す
title.romaji: Kemonohito Ou wa Ikenie Hanayome wo Tsumigoto Aisu

198968.description: Manga adaptation of Leo Tolstoy's 1878 novel "Anna Karenina"

198970.description:
Struggling actor Hyeon-Su Kim suddenly gains a strange ability after an accident: he can dream the dreams of the dead. These aren’t hazy nightmares or random visions, but vivid relivings of emotions and experiences that don’t belong to him. When Hyeon-Su channels those experiences into his roles, his acting becomes terrifyingly real, as if he’s truly possessed. But how far can a haunted genius go before the dreams start consuming him?

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: Coming Some〜誤解から始まるロマンス〜

198972.description:
If there’s one thing Do Haejoo loves more than her job, it’s handsome men. But after a breakup and a career blunder that lands her a week off, her luck turns around when she finds a mysterious flyer for a cleaning service exclusively for women. The cleaner who shows up is not only competent—he's drop-dead gorgeous and awakens her dull world with his special services. Is this the beginning of Haejoo's very own love story or a messy temptation that's too hot to handle?

(Source: Tapas)

198973.description:
Aoling, busy eating and drinking recklessly in Tokyo. Feeling ashamed of my weight-gaining self-pity, I decide to join a fasting center... but upon further investigation, I discover that the Jeju Island fasting center offers healing and weight loss! Dreaming of killing two birds with one stone—travel and diet—I head to Jeju. There, I meet diverse people and discover a side of Jeju I'd never known before... Will I truly be able to lose weight? Always busy touring famous tourist spots and eating and drinking, can I truly discover Jeju through a different lens?

Aoling, a reckless housewife, shares her diet and Jeju conquest story! Stay tuned!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

198974.description:
A Korean couple living in Tokyo (Aoling and her husband) suddenly decide to open a Korean restaurant one day. Seeing the success of other Korean restaurants in Tokyo, they set out with high hopes... but business is far from easy. From the location to the interior, the taste, and even the customer service, nothing is easy. They regret underestimating the value of business and struggle to keep it afloat. Days pass, and customers arrive one by one...

What kind of customers will they meet? Will their business survive? Stay tuned for this captivating story of a small business!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

198975.description:
“I think I’ll… fail if I try to twist the original work?!”

I'd been reincarnated into my favorite romance novel, which I'd reread countless times, even down to the spinoffs. And to top it all off, I was a pathetic, villainous princess who'd been engaged to the crown prince and met a tragic end. To avoid dying, I decided to twist the original story. But...

"I brought you the engagement letter to the Northern Grand Duke, Lily!"

A few days later, this crazy dad arrived with the Northern Grand Duke's engagement letter instead of the crown prince's.

"You've loved me for a long time, Princess."

And he even included a real-life version of the Northern Grand Duke. The bigger problem is... The Northern Grand Duke, the original male protagonist, is determined to seduce me.

"Do you know? How much those eyes confuse my heart."

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: I Tried to Twist the Original Story But Ended Up Seducing the Northern Duke
I Tried to Rewrite the Original Story, But Ended Up Seducing the Northern Grand Duke

198978.description:
That's the nature of fate. You never know where it will lead. But it will inevitably reach someone. Just as the wind can only disperse and never be stopped, the path taken by those born with a legendary destiny is unstoppable. Here lies Yongcheonsan, a mountain where legends and those who pursue them become legends themselves.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

198979.description:
Why is it called Pungsa (風邪)? Because it's like a cold that sticks to you no matter how much you try to shake it off. Does that mean only others will suffer? Your life will be harder. You'll have to walk a thorny path. It's okay. I'll live and laugh. I'll live with a smile. So don't worry. And so the entire martial arts world was struck by Pungsa. The exciting, arduous, and exhilarating adventures of the Pungsa gang that set the entire martial arts world ablaze!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

198981.description:
The Eight Rules of the Lower Class:
1. A lower class must be cunning.
2. A lower class must be quick-witted.
3. A lower class must never get angry.
4. A lower class must never draw a sword recklessly.
5. A lower class must not cause trouble.
6. A lower class must stay away from beautiful women.
7. A lower class must never associate with lower class people.
8. A lower class must know their place.

I realized long ago that if I kept to these Eight Rules of the Lower Class, I could act as a master.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

198983.description:
When her fiance, the crown prince, finds a new saint, Saint Mira is branded a "fake saint," exiled, and their engagement is broken off. Surprised by this sudden turn of events, Mira asks the swordsman Raul, whom she met at the adventurer's guild, to escort her and begins her journey back to her homeland. During her journey, Mira discovers a previously unknown strength in her own magic. Furthermore, by deepening her bond with the swordsman, she unleashes her extraordinary "saintly powers"!? Meanwhile, troubles arise one after another in the royal capital from which Mira was exiled...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Fake Saint?! Mira's Tale of Adventures

title.native: 偽聖女!? ミラの冒険譚　～追放されましたが、実は最強なのでセカンドライフを楽しみます！～
title.romaji: Nise Seijo!? Mira no Boukentan: Tsuihou Saremashita ga Jisuha Saikyou nanode Second Life wo Tanoshimimasu!

198984.description:
Livia Plington is out of luck. Not only was her fortune stolen, but she's caught a fatal disease, and the only thing that can save her is the mysterious heirloom of House Mercedes. Livia's solution? Infiltrate Mercedes Manor as the young lord's private tutor and find the heirloom herself! But as Livia plays teacher, she comes to care for her student and even the tragic Duke Mercedes too. Can she heal the hearts of this family as well as heal herself? Or is this terminal teacher doomed to die?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Terminally Ill Lady Fakes a Job with the Villain Family
The Time-limited Extra Is Disguised as a Tutor in a Villain’s House
The Terminally Ill Woman Goes Undercover at the Villainous Family

title.english: The Terminal Teacher in the Doomed Duke's House

198985.description: After witnessing the bullying of Kang Eun-Su for being openly lesbian, Cha Su-Hyun holds back the fact that she also likes girls. But Kang Eun-Su's presence forces Cha Su-Hyun to confront her own feelings and memories. Now she must face her fear, the monster in the closet.

198986.description:
Seishiro Sakaki leads an unremarkable college life. One day, a beautiful woman with elegant features moves in across from his boarding house. As Sakaki's feelings for her grow, his affection slowly takes a dark and twisted turn...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

198987.description:
Why Blue Carp Town sank? Was there anything to do with The Lord of the River? Why Cait Ching strayed into the underwater city? Is it a coincident or fate? When crisis strikes, should we be satisfied with the existing state as they are? Caiting Ching found the question. Hope she can find the answers as well.

(Source: WebComics)

198988.description:
I want to see her breasts with an embarrassed look on her face. A boy's dream comes true here! A senior at university shows off her big breasts with kindness. A serious junior who looks good in glasses has softer breasts than you'd imagine. A high school teacher lets you touch her mature breasts in the classroom without the students knowing. A collection of blushing breasts that will make your heart flutter with excitement at the cuteness and softness of these girls.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: どこ見てるかバレバレだよ？ カザマアヤミ作品集
title.romaji: Doko Miteru ka Barebare da yo? Kazama Ayami Sakuhinshuu

198989.description:
One day, Makoto is suddenly confessed to by a high school boy, Shun-kun, and Makoto spontaneously gives him his contact information. Unable to tell Shun-kun that he is a "cross-dressing older man," Makoto is wracked with feelings of guilt. However, as he deepens his relationship with admirable and pure-hearted Shun-kun, Makoto realizes his feelings have changed...? How will the love between a beautiful older man and a high school boy turn out?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: きれいなおじさんは、好きですか。
title.romaji: Kirei na Ojisan wa, Suki desu ka.

198990.description:
Aoi Kinoshita is a clumsy woman who one day becomes the center of affection of Mori Kujou, an up and coming executive and incoming president of a company.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
synonyms: Please Go Ahead and Spoil Me

198992.description: Note: Published in Comic Grape Vol.107

198993.description:
The story centers on Hino Mari, a 32-year-old apparel shop worker. Her catchphrase is "It's not my fault," and when she spills coffee on someone on a rush-hour commuter train, she blames them, saying, "You're the one who invaded my personal space," and "You sensed I might get caught, but you didn't move away. That's poor crisis management." Then, at her workplace, Kurata Aoi, a self-blaming woman, appears, always thinking she's to blame whenever trouble arises. Mari, who sees Aoi as her enemy, tries to control her position by believing she's the victim no matter what happens at work, but...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: だってワタシは悪くない

198994.description:
Count Amelia, daughter of the Countess, has been abused by her family and disliked by her fiancé, Cedric, who sees her as unsociable. Amelia lives a life supported by her beloved job as a pharmacist, but one day, someone comes to visit... Cedric, who has been poisoned by someone and turned into a squirrel!?

"Please let me stay in this room," Amelia pleads, and so begins her strange cohabitation with her fluffy fiancé (the squirrel)!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: リスになってしまった婚約者が、毛嫌いしていたはずの私に助けを求めてきました。
title.romaji: Risu ni Natte Shimatta Konyakusha ga, Kegirai Shite Ita Hazu no Watashi ni Tasuke wo Motomete Kimashita.

title.native: 田舎で初エッチ! 一生忘れられないひと夏の経験アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Inaka de Hatsu Ecchi! Isshou Wasurerarenai Hitonatsunokeiken Anthology Comic

198996.description:
The one who saved the oppressed young lady was... a squirrel.

Amelia, the daughter of an earl, was abused by her family and hated by her fiancé Cedric, who considered her unfriendly.But that didn't bother her. One day, while she was finding comfort in her beloved job as a pharmacist, someone came to visit her...Cedric, who had been poisoned by someone and turned into a squirrel!?

"Please let me stay in this room," he demanded her, and so began this strange cohabitation with her nagging, fluffy fiancé (the squirrel).

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: リスになってしまった婚約者が、毛嫌いしていたはずの私に助けを求めてきました。
title.romaji: Risu ni Natte Shimatta Konyakusha ga, Kegirai Shite Ita Hazu no Watashi ni Tasuke wo Motomete Kimashita.

title.native: 一身上の都合で（悪辣）侯爵様の契約メイドになりました
title.romaji: Isshinjou no Tsugou de (Akuratsu) Koushaku-sama no Keiyaku Maid ni Narimashita

198998.description:
Lacking magical powers, Sphere, the daughter of an earl, has been confined to her mansion since she was a child. When her stepmother and stepsister arrive after her father remarries, she realizes she has been reincarnated as the heroine of an otome game. She immediately uses her knowledge of games to acquire the powers of a saint and enrolls in the magic school where the game is set. Her goal is to be united with Ewald, one of the characters she loved even before her reincarnation. She then goes on to save the villainous character who has fallen into darkness and find happiness. This is the story of a hyper-positive heroine's reincarnation in an otome game!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Beloved Saint is Trying to Save the Villain Who Has Fallen Into Darkness

title.native: 愛され聖女は闇堕ち悪役を救いたい
title.romaji: Aisare Seijo wa Yamiochi Akayuku wo Sukuitai
